+1 Weapon Potency Crystal.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.
+1 Weapon Potency Crystal.name: +1 Weapon Potency Crystal

+2 Weapon Potency Crystal.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +2 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from two orbital crystals.
+2 Weapon Potency Crystal.name: +2 Weapon Potency Crystal

+3 Weapon Potency Crystal.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +3 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from three orbital crystals.
+3 Weapon Potency Crystal.name: +3 Weapon Potency Crystal

Abadarcorp Travel Suit.description:
Upgrades: 2

AbadarCorp executives popularized these armored business suits for boardrooms and battle. Contingent force fields and concealed plating protect the wearer in hostile situations. Higher grades of travel suits offer more protection—along with a designer label.
Abadarcorp Travel Suit.name: Abadarcorp Travel Suit

Acid Dart Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle uses compressed air to shoot tiny, chambered darts loaded with components for a highly corrosive compound that remains separated until launched, allowing for nearly unlimited shelf life with minimal risk of accidental exposure.
Acid Dart Rifle.name: Acid Dart Rifle

Active Camouflage (Advanced).description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +3 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.
Active Camouflage (Advanced).name: Active Camouflage (Advanced)

Active Camouflage (Commercial).description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.
Active Camouflage (Commercial).name: Active Camouflage (Commercial)

Active Camouflage (Tactical).description: Hardlight projectors shift the appearance of your armor using shifting colors and patterns that respond to your environment. You gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks while wearing the armor.
Active Camouflage (Tactical).name: Active Camouflage (Tactical)

Adaptive Energy Shielding.description:
This device changes the chemical composition of the insulation installed on your armor, reacting to different types of energy.

Activate—Adapt r

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You take acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

Effect Your energy shielding upgrade changes to the triggering damage type. This lasts until you Adapt again or uninstall any adaptive energy shielding or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ]{Energy Shielding} upgrade from the same armor. If you have multiple energy shielding upgrades on this armor, choose one to change when you Adapt.
Adaptive Energy Shielding.name: Adaptive Energy Shielding

Aegis Series.description:
Upgrades: 0

Aegis armor suits are starmetal-infused shells that encase the wearer entirely, including an attached visorless helmet that's often sculpted into a custom style. Sensors built into the suit feed sensory information to the wearer, and powered limbs aid maneuvers. Movement in an aegis suit is clumsy, but powerful.
Aegis Series.name: Aegis Series

Aeon Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 0

A mainstay of the Azlanti Star Empire, this sleek laser rifle includes a slot for aeon stones to enhance and focus the intensity of its beams.
Aeon Rifle.name: Aeon Rifle

Aeon Stone (Guiding).description:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This gold star glitters with joyful energy. Its resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} as an occult innate cantrip.

Activate—Cosmic Luck 1 (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check

Effect You change the critical failure into a failure.
Aeon Stone (Guiding).name: Aeon Stone (Guiding)

The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE]{Life Seal} as a divine innate spell once per day.
Aeon Stone (Life-Giving).name: Aeon Stone (Life-Giving)

Activate—Navigate 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You concentrate on a Drift beacon you've visited before and mentally chart a course for that location. You immediately know which direction to travel to reach your destination, and your journey takes 1 day less if you're piloting the ship.

This deep-blue prism with cloudy inclusions is light as a feather. Its resonant power gives you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate—Fly Free 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a fly Speed for 1 minute equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.xZ5XMY55S42aGyjg]{Effect: Aeon Stone (Uplifting)}
Aeon Stone (Uplifting).name: Aeon Stone (Uplifting)

Akashic Lens (Advanced).description:
Worn as a contact lens, spectacles, or other eyewear, these magically treated lenses project a special data display that uses virtual intelligence and rapid eye tracking to quickly cycle through information until you find what you seek. It grants you a +2 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks with the skill chosen when you use Database Scan.

Activate—Database Scan 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The lens casts a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.VynaowCerc7B4yvI]{Akashic Download} that uses the lens instead of a comm unit.
Akashic Lens (Advanced).name: Akashic Lens (Advanced)

Animated Intelligence (Advanced).description:
Magical circuitry generates a virtual animated intelligence with a customizable personality and no free will. Rarely, a virtual intelligence might eventually evolve into a true artificial intelligence with self-awareness and free will, usually with the help of powerful magic or a miracle.

Activate—Autoattack 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect You Release the weapon and it glides through the air, fighting on its own against the last enemy you attacked, or the nearest enemy to it if your target has been defeated. At the end of your turn each round, the weapon can Fly up to its fly Speed of 60 feet, and then can either Fly again or Strike one creature within its range or reach.

The weapon has a space of 5 feet, but it doesn't block or impede enemies attempting to move though that space. It provides but does not benefit from flanking. The animated intelligence is considered a technological creature for the purpose of effects that can target it. The weapon can't move through an enemy's space. The weapon can't use reactions, and its Fly actions don't trigger reactions.

While it's activated, the animated intelligence Strikes with an attack modifier of +32 plus its item bonus to attack rolls. It uses the weapon's normal damage but has a +0 Strength and Dexterity modifier. The weapon's abilities that automatically trigger on a hit or critical hit still function, but the weapon can't be activated or benefit from any of your abilities while animated.

Each round, when the weapon finishes using its actions, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:4]. On a failure, the activation ends. The weapon falls to the ground and can't Autoattack again for 10 minutes.
Animated Intelligence (Advanced).name: Animated Intelligence (Advanced)

Antigrav Harness (Advanced).description:
This convoluted web of synthweave straps is worn as a fashion statement in some subcultures but has a useful application in extreme environments. You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks, and you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or clumsy while untethered in zero-g.

Activate—Gravity Alteration 1 (manipulate)

Effect You treat gravity as being two steps higher or lower (for example, zero-g becomes standard gravity, low gravity becomes high gravity, standard gravity becomes extreme gravity, or vice versa). This only affects you, your gear, and your movement and lasts 1 minute.
Antigrav Harness (Advanced).name: Antigrav Harness (Advanced)

Activate—Gravity Alteration 1 (manipulate)

Effect You treat gravity as being one step higher or lower (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity, or vice versa). This only affects you, your gear, and your movement and lasts until the end of your next turn.

Arc Emitter.description:
Upgrades: 1

Composed of two 4-foot-long protracting rails, this weapon shoots arcs of electricity at targets, emitted safely away from its wielder.
Arc Emitter.name: Arc Emitter

Arc Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.
Arc Pistol.name: Arc Pistol

Arc Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle's oversized body contains a larger version of an arc pistol capacitor, with a short barrel and polycarbon stock designed to insulate the wielder from high voltage. The arc rifle's larger capacitor allows it to produce a charge with enough power to subdue a rampaging renkroda.
Arc Rifle.name: Arc Rifle

Archaic Text.description: This book could be a religious text, a collection of ancient recipes, a romance novel, or vintage mechanical schematics.
Archaic Text.name: Archaic Text

Armored Coat.description:
Upgrades: 1

This overcoat is made of real or synthetic leather and reinforced with armored plates. Armored coats are often tailor-made to match the wearer's personal style. Standard versions are issued to military officers as part of their uniforms.
Armored Coat.name: Armored Coat

Armored Copi Exoskeleton.description: Your armored copi exoskeleton grants a +3 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and has the comfort and exposed traits. You're trained in your exoskeleton. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can't install armor upgrades or etch armor runes onto your exoskeleton.
Armored Copi Exoskeleton.name: Armored Copi Exoskeleton

Armplates.description: You've undergone the extensive process to develop scaled armplates like your ancestors. Your armplates function like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.j66fZJrm1nECG3UM]{commercial dermal plating} augmentation, except they are a permanent part of your body, don't have the tech trait, and don't take an augmentation slot. You can spend credits to upgrade your armplates as if they were dermal plating.
Armplates.name: Armplates

Artificial Immortalizer.description:
This extra organ assimilates with and enhances your circulatory and immune systems. When you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing disease or poison, you recover completely, regardless of its current stage. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Life Buffer 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain 50 temporary Hit Points, which last for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.68zoB7dwKUcmEO1R]{Effect: Artificial Immortalizer}
Artificial Immortalizer.name: Artificial Immortalizer

Artillery Laser.description:
Upgrades: 1

The fast-firing and continuous beams of this laser cannon converge on the target to create enough heat to melt a steel door into slag.
Artillery Laser.name: Artillery Laser

Assassin Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sniper rifle breaks down into small parts, allowing its wielder to smuggle the weapon without attracting attention. Most assassin rifles are equipped with powerful scopes and digital sights.
Assassin Rifle.name: Assassin Rifle

Assault Briefcase (Advanced).description:
This hard-shelled briefcase can hold up to 1 Bulk of documents and equipment. You can install shields and weapons into your assault briefcase, but they must be the same grade or lower than the briefcase.

You can Install a one-handed ranged weapon of 1 Bulk or less into the assault briefcase. You gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal} a Weapon installed in the assault briefcase (+4 if the weapon has the concealable trait). You can deploy the installed weapon with an Interact action, allowing you to wield it in one hand while holding the briefcase.

You can Install a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.ZIIEmh2nAnST6vGk]{Deflecting Field} into the assault briefcase and use it as though it were armor. If you use a weapon integrated into the briefcase for any purpose while the shield is raised, the shield is no longer raised, and you no longer receive a bonus to your AC.
Assault Briefcase (Advanced).name: Assault Briefcase (Advanced)

You can Install a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.ZIIEmh2nAnST6vGk]{Deflecting Field} into the assault briefcase and use it as though it were armor. If you use a weapon integrated into the briefcase for any purpose while the shield is raised, the shield is no longer raised, and you no longer receive a bonus to your AC.
Assault Briefcase (Ultimate).name: Assault Briefcase (Ultimate)

Aucturnite Chakram.description:
Upgrades: 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of aucturnite and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has mysteriously appeared light-years from Aucturn's original orbit.
Aucturnite Chakram.name: Aucturnite Chakram

Aural Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d6[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:10], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 3d8.
Aural Grenade (Advanced).name: Aural Grenade (Advanced)

Aural Grenade (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:5], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 1d8.
Aural Grenade (Commercial).name: Aural Grenade (Commercial)

Aural Grenade (Elite).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d6[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:15], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 10d8.
Aural Grenade (Elite).name: Aural Grenade (Elite)

Aural Grenade (Paragon).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d8[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:20], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 14d8.
Aural Grenade (Paragon).name: Aural Grenade (Paragon)

Aural Grenade (Superior).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d6[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:15], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 8d8.
Aural Grenade (Superior).name: Aural Grenade (Superior)

Aural Grenade (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d4[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:10], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 2d8.
Aural Grenade (Tactical).name: Aural Grenade (Tactical)

Aural Grenade (Ultimate).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d8[bleed]]

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:20], and the nonlethal sonic damage is 12d8.
Aural Grenade (Ultimate).name: Aural Grenade (Ultimate)

Auto-CPR Unit.description: This device monitors your vital signs and automatically administers aid. When you have the dying condition while wearing this armor, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 8 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value).
Auto-CPR Unit.name: Auto-CPR Unit

Autodreamer.description: A microchip embedded into your nervous system activates whenever you sleep, immersing you in constant lucid dreams unless you choose to sleep normally. Once per day when you awaken after getting a full 8 hours of sleep, you count as having spent a day of downtime retraining. Your dreams draw from your own experiences, so you can't use them for retraining that requires an instructor or specialized knowledge.
Autodreamer.name: Autodreamer

Autograppler (Commercial).description: You can attach this anchoring device to a cable line with an Interact action. Clamps automatically slide from the base of the autograppler along the attached cable, allowing it to be climbed like a knotted rope. You can throw the autograppler to attach it to a solid surface, attempting a ranged attack roll using your simple weapon proficiency against a DC depending on the target, typically at least DC 20. This attack has the secret trait. On a success, your autograppler has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the grappler seems like it will hold but detaches when you're partway up.
Autograppler (Commercial).name: Autograppler (Commercial)

Autograppler (Tactical).description:
You can attach this anchoring device to a cable line with an Interact action. Clamps automatically slide from the base of the autograppler along the attached cable, allowing it to be climbed like a knotted rope. You can throw the autograppler to attach it to a solid surface, attempting a ranged attack roll using your simple weapon proficiency against a DC depending on the target, typically at least DC 20. This attack has the secret trait. On a success, your autograppler has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the grappler seems like it will hold but detaches when you're partway up.

A tactical autograppler has a sensor to detect whether it has a firm hold, causing it to automatically retract if you critically fail your ranged attack to attach it.
Autograppler (Tactical).name: Autograppler (Tactical)

Autorecognition Lens.description: An artificial eye lens microscopically wired into your brain automatically tracks a database of associated names and faces as you meet or interact with individuals. After you've learned someone's name and appearance, a tiny HUD displays their name to you whenever you're looking at them as long as you're aware of their presence and their appearance hasn't dramatically changed (at the GM's discretion). This doesn't help you see or identify people who are trying to hide or disguise their appearance. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Autorecognition Lens.name: Autorecognition Lens

Autotarget Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This short, bulky assault rifle incorporates a piston system that allows the user to switch to auto-fire and unload a magazine with one trigger squeeze.
Autotarget Rifle.name: Autotarget Rifle

Barathu Shell.description: This shell counts as medium armor in the composite armor group. It grants a +2 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +2, a check penalty of –2, a Strength threshold of +2, and has the comfort and exposed traits. This item bonus increases to +3 at 5th level. You're trained in your shell. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your shell, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Barathu Shell.name: Barathu Shell

Basic Environmental Protection.description: This upgrade protects the user against the effects of space as well as thick and thin atmospheres. This armor loses the exposed trait for as long as the upgrade is installed.
Basic Environmental Protection.name: Basic Environmental Protection

Baton.description:
Upgrades: 1

This reinforced rod is commonly made from metal alloys and designed to strike and parry incoming blows.
Baton.name: Baton

Battle Ribbon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sheer nanocarbon ribbon is sharp enough to cut through flesh without interrupting the traditional battle dances that make the weapon famous.
Battle Ribbon.name: Battle Ribbon

Battleglove.description:
Upgrades: 1

These durable gloves fit over a wielder's hands (or other appendages) and feature weighted plates or spikes over the knuckles.
Battleglove.name: Battleglove

Bipod (Advanced).description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

You can Interact as a free action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.

Once per round, you can either deploy or retrieve this automatic bipod as a free action instead of an Interact action.
Bipod (Advanced).name: Bipod (Advanced)

Bipod (Commercial).description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

However, you must spend a single Interact action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.
Bipod (Commercial).name: Bipod (Commercial)

Bipod (Tactical).description:
A bipod can be attached to powerful weapons—those with the kickback trait—to allow wielders with lower Strength to use them at the cost of mobility. You can set up the bipod with a single Interact action using one appendage, setting the bipod in your square. When using a bipod, you don't take the –2 penalty for firing a kickback weapon, even if your Strength isn't high enough to avoid the penalty.

You can Interact as a free action to retrieve the bipod before you can move the weapon to a different position. Deploying or retrieving a bipod with an Interact action doesn't automatically make you observed like an Interact action normally would, so long as you don't set up or remove the bipod when it's in a spot where creatures can see it.
Bipod (Tactical).name: Bipod (Tactical)

Bledstick.description: Bledsticks are illegal modifications to credsticks that impale anyone who attempts to use the credstick other than its authorized owner. A bledstick is matched to a single authorized user's biometric profile when Installed into the credstick. If any other creature uses the credstick, needles immediately erupt from the sides and surface of the bledstick, dealing @Damage[1d4[persistent,bleed]] damage and drawing a sample of blood from the unauthorized user that can be used to identify or track the creature later. An authorized creature can disable the bledstick for any amount of time for up to 24 hours.
Bledstick.name: Bledstick

Blockthrower.description: Salvaged from the set of Sabotage Soufflé (a popular cooking competition), these frosty weapons draw liquid from a tank through hypercooling coils to quickly generate gigantic blocks of ice that can be slung at high velocity toward their targets.
Blockthrower.name: Blockthrower

Bone Scepter.description:
Upgrades: 1

This engraved club of solid bone is tempered using material from the void that can drain life energy.
Bone Scepter.name: Bone Scepter

Bone Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This black sludge is distilled from elebrian bone matter and tastes like mint. Upon drinking it, you gain void healing for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Crg77XKCHxittH5a]{Effect: Bone Serum}
Bone Serum.name: Bone Serum

Bone Speaker Bobblehead.description: Marketed toward living tourists in Pact Port, these festive dolls are fashioned in the likenesses of prominent bone sages, most popularly the media mogul Zo!. Any living creature carrying a bone speaker bobblehead in one hand can speak and understand the Necril language. This does not let them understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like unless you can bypass the limitations of a computer-assisted translation app, such as with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Bi0wdUuHsLxvSqrJ]{Digital Ambassador} skill feat.
Bone Speaker Bobblehead.name: Bone Speaker Bobblehead

Boom Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

A boom pistol resembles a megaphone with a trigger, emitting sudden bursts of sound capable of shattering bulletproof glass or rupturing organs.
Boom Pistol.name: Boom Pistol

Boundary Spray Paint.description: When this paint is sprayed onto a wall, the paint remains even if the wall is drastically changed by supernatural effects, such as the layout of the Ghost Levels changing. You gain a +2 item bonus to rolls to navigate the Ghost Floors and similar liminal areas.
Boundary Spray Paint.name: Boundary Spray Paint

Breaching Gun.description:
Upgrades: 1

This snub-nosed scattergun is commonly used to blast through doors and walls. Smaller than a reaction breacher, this scattergun is infamous for its mighty recoil.
Breaching Gun.name: Breaching Gun

Cable Line (50 Feet, Commercial).description: This industrial cable is typically made of high-durability plastic coated in metal. A commercial cable line is coated in titanium alloy.
Cable Line (50 Feet, Commercial).name: Cable Line (50 Feet, Commercial)

Cable Line (50 Feet, Tactical).description: This industrial cable is typically made of high-durability plastic coated in metal. A tactical cable line is coated in adamantine alloy.
Cable Line (50 Feet, Tactical).name: Cable Line (50 Feet, Tactical)

Cairn Form Spell Amp (Commercial).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Type commercial cairn form spell amp; Level 7; Price 720 credits

Effect 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HAaRcHfN4g83eSEC]{Cairn Form} spell
Cairn Form Spell Amp (Commercial).name: Cairn Form Spell Amp (Commercial)

Cairn Form Spell Amp (Tactical).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HAaRcHfN4g83eSEC]{Cairn Form} spell
Cairn Form Spell Amp (Tactical).name: Cairn Form Spell Amp (Tactical)

Camping Kit.description: A camping kit contains a weatherproof tent for four Medium or two Large creatures, bedrolls, a fire igniter, 1 week of rations, and a survival knife.
Camping Kit.name: Camping Kit

Carbon Shield.description: This durable yet lightweight defensive plate comes in a variety of shapes and sizes, and it's often customized with LED displays that broadcast personal insignia or an organization's colors and symbols.
Carbon Shield.name: Carbon Shield

Carbon Skin.description:
Upgrades: 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Most are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.
Carbon Skin.name: Carbon Skin

Card Slinger.description:
Upgrade: 1

This ceramic weapon sharpens and fires playing cards, such as those from an infinity deck. Their folding design and innocuous ammunition make it ideal for infiltrating secure locations, especially casinos. While the weapon often relies on lucky hits, in the hands of a gambler familiar with card trajectory, it can become deadly.
Card Slinger.name: Card Slinger

Cardiac Accelerator.description:
This implant integrates directly into your heart. You can trigger the accelerator to briefly overclock your body's cardiovascular system.

Activate—Accelerate f

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You Climb, Stride, or Swim

Effect You increase your Speed by 20 feet for the triggering action.
Cardiac Accelerator.name: Cardiac Accelerator

Celebrity Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This fizzy pink concoction is mildly intoxicating and grants a +1 item bonus to Performance checks for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.dCDZQr7EBfCALmT2]{Effect: Celebrity Serum}
Celebrity Serum.name: Celebrity Serum

Cellular Stimulant Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QiW8VNdBf0SFUq69]{Cellular Stimulant} spell (DC 15)
Cellular Stimulant Spell Amp.name: Cellular Stimulant Spell Amp

Chemalyzer.description: This handheld sampling unit grants a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks to identify an unknown drug, medicinal, poison, or other chemical substance.
Chemalyzer.name: Chemalyzer

Chitinous Plates.description: Your chitinous plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, with a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and have the analog, comfort, and exposed traits. You're trained in your chitinous plates. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit} over your exoskeleton, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your chitinous plates, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Chitinous Plates.name: Chitinous Plates

Chitinous Shield.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.yWUKpu1ImB0vfXvB]{Chitinous Shield}

You have a growth of particularly durable chitin on your arm that you can use as a shield. This shield doesn't need to be held in your hand, and it can't be disarmed. Your shield has an AC bonus of +2, Hardness 4, 12 Hit Points, and a Broken Threshold of 6. If your shield becomes broken, it can't be repaired until you are restored to full health and spend 10 minutes readjusting your chitin. You can spend 1 day of downtime and expend raw materials (such as UPBs) to improve the grade of your shield, but only to a grade up to your level (such as advanced if you're level 8 or higher). Use the level, price, Hardness, HP, and BT adjustments in the Shield Improvements table.
Chitinous Shield.name: Chitinous Shield

Climbing Kit (Commercial).description:
A commercial climbing kit includes 50 feet of cable line, a grappling hook, harnesses, pulleys, pitons, a hammer, and crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall.

A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.
Climbing Kit (Commercial).name: Climbing Kit (Commercial)

Climbing Kit (Tactical).description:
A commercial climbing kit includes 50 feet of cable line, a grappling hook, harnesses, pulleys, pitons, a hammer, and crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're Climbing, moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5] whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb while using a tactical climbing kit.

A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit.
Climbing Kit (Tactical).name: Climbing Kit (Tactical)

Cloaking Device (Commercial).description:
This projector bends light around your body.

Activate—Bend Light 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 1 minute, gaining the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell.
Cloaking Device (Commercial).name: Cloaking Device (Commercial)

Cloaking Device (Tactical).description:
This projector bends light around your body.

Activate—Bend Light 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 1 minute, gaining the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell.
Cloaking Device (Tactical).name: Cloaking Device (Tactical)

Cloaking Skin (Advanced).description:
Many of your pores are replaced with magically regulated and directed holographic projectors that synchronize when activated to automatically match your surroundings, rendering you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}.

Activate—Cloak 1 (concentrate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect You gain the effects of 4nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} for 1 minute or until you spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to deactivate it.
Cloaking Skin (Advanced).name: Cloaking Skin (Advanced)

Cloaking Skin (Commercial).description:
Many of your pores are replaced with magically regulated and directed holographic projectors that synchronize when activated to automatically match your surroundings, rendering you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}.

Activate—Cloak 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain the effects of 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} for 1 minute or until you spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to deactivate it.
Cloaking Skin (Commercial).name: Cloaking Skin (Commercial)

Cloaking Skin (Tactical).description:
Many of your pores are replaced with magically regulated and directed holographic projectors that synchronize when activated to automatically match your surroundings, rendering you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}.

Activate—Cloak 1 (concentrate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect You gain the effects of 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} for 1 minute or until you spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to deactivate it.
Cloaking Skin (Tactical).name: Cloaking Skin (Tactical)

Coat of the Crawl.description: This coat's slick oilcloth outer shell provides a strangely useful lubrication while moving through tight spaces or while prone. You can move up to half your normal move Speed when you [[/act crawl]]. Additionally, you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} 5 feet per round.
Coat of the Crawl.name: Coat of the Crawl

Cognition Accelerator.description:
A miniature supercomputer augments your brain's ability to process information. You gain a +3 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with any skill. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Intelligence modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence modifier. You must select skills and languages when the augmentation is first installed, and they can't be changed.

Activate—Access Database 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect Immediately attempt three checks to Recall Knowledge about related topics, selecting each topic after learning the results of the prior checks. If you would fail one of these checks, you succeed instead.
Cognition Accelerator.name: Cognition Accelerator

Coil Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

The barrel of this rifle is surrounded by a coil that accelerates ammunition with power and accuracy using carefully aligned magnetic fields.
Coil Rifle.name: Coil Rifle

Comm Unit.description:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
Comm Unit.name: Comm Unit

Commando Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This tangy crimson elixir grants you 1d10+5 temporary Hit Points, as well as a +5-foot item bonus to any Speed you have for 1 minute. When you drink this serum, your veins protrude, and your eyes take on a reddish tinge.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.uf3Fb7Fm7dSzc7Os]{Effect: Commando Serum}
Commando Serum.name: Commando Serum

Compact Shield.description: This sleek shield is a favorite of operatives and other mobile combatants. It's most common design is a polycarbon panel contoured to fit snugly over a forearm or other limb.
Compact Shield.name: Compact Shield

Congealer Incense (Advanced).description:
This delicate strand of incense is packaged in a hand-blown glass vial and crafted from petrified wood of centuries-old Eoxian trees, peppered with a tincture of elebrian ashes and enchanted sand from the Deminas Ocean. When exposed to air by breaking the container, the incense bursts into cloying, lavender-scented smoke that sticks to incorporeal creatures and stabilizes their form.

Activate—Break Open 1 (manipulate)

Duration 1 minute

Effect Purple smoke billows out from the incense in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. At the start of each round, this emanation increases by 5 feet (to a maximum of 30 feet). The creature who activated the congealer incense can drop it in a space as a free action, or can continue to carry it with them in 1 hand, thus moving the center of the emanation on that creature's turn. Any incorporeal creature who enters this area or begins their turn inside of it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Treat the incorporeal creature's resistances as 4 lower.

Failure As success, but the creature loses all immunity to precision damage and treats its resistances as 8 lower.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
Congealer Incense (Advanced).name: Congealer Incense (Advanced)

Consecrated Keycaps.description:
These strange keycaps were left as a gift at the memorial of the deceased anacite, Tier-99-Professor.

Activate—Idle Typing 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ZBeKxBcUOsXrfMRo]{Implant Data} spell.
Consecrated Keycaps.name: Consecrated Keycaps

Container (Designer).description:
Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.

You gain a +1 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on high society individuals while carrying a designer container, such as a designer handbag.
Container (Designer).name: Container (Designer)

Container (Ordinary).description: Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.
Container (Ordinary).name: Container (Ordinary)

Cosmic Connector.description:
This augmentation opens your mind to the underlying cosmic truths of the universe. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Wisdom modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Reground in Reality r (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail a saving throw against a magical effect

Effect You can reroll the save and use the better result.
Cosmic Connector.name: Cosmic Connector

Crossbolter.description:
Upgrades: 1

This high-tech crossbow uses a series of pistons to propel bolts along its barrel. These quiet-firing semiautomatic weapons are popular in high-density settlements where gunfire might cause a panic.
Crossbolter.name: Crossbolter

Cryopike.description:
Upgrades: 1

This polearm's shaft houses rapidly circulating supercooled gas that condenses and channels endothermic energy into a cryogenic blade.
Cryopike.name: Cryopike

Cryoplate.description:
Internal magical components, often crafted from cold siccitite or a similar material, keep the surface of this thin, 1 foot– diameter disc just below the local freezing point of water. Used as the centerpiece of upscale catering set-ups to keep chilly treats or ice sculptures from melting, the cryoplate can also be put to tactical purposes in a pinch.

Activate—Flash Freezer Trap 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You prime the cryoplate and throw it up to 30 feet, creating a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-foot radius burst} of sudden freezing temperature that makes the area difficult terrain for 1 minute. Any creatures occupying or attempting to move through the affected terrain must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until it leaves the difficult terrain, and for 1 round thereafter.

Failure As success, except the target is suppressed for 2 rounds thereafter.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Cryoplate.name: Cryoplate

Crystallized Shockshard (Advanced).description:
Activate f (concentrate)

Trigger You deal damage to a creature with the weapon.

This electric-blue crystal crackles with energy. When you activate the shockshard, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute. If the target has the tech trait, it instead becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.

Cycling Crystal.description:
A cycling crystal gives you greater control over the cycle of energies flowing through your solar manifestations.

Activate—Halt Cycle f (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You critically hit with your solar weapon or solar flare as part of an action with the cycle trait

Effect You can choose whether to change your attunement state or remain in your current attunement state.
Cycling Crystal.name: Cycling Crystal

Darkvision Capacitors (Commercial).description: These replacement cybernetic eyes grant you darkvision. Darkvision capacitors operate by emitting low-powered ultraviolet lasers that receptors in the capacitors can detect. These lasers are visible to creatures that can see on the ultraviolet light spectrum.
Darkvision Capacitors (Commercial).name: Darkvision Capacitors (Commercial)

Darkvision Capacitors (Tactical).description:
These replacement cybernetic eyes grant you darkvision. Darkvision capacitors operate by emitting low-powered ultraviolet lasers that receptors in the capacitors can detect. These lasers are visible to creatures that can see on the ultraviolet light spectrum.

These upgraded capacitors include a wide-spectrum ocular implant that allows you to see infrared and ultraviolet light, including the lasers from other darkvision capacitors. You gain darkvision and a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} if they involve sight.
Darkvision Capacitors (Tactical).name: Darkvision Capacitors (Tactical)

Darkvision Visor.description: This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.
Darkvision Visor.name: Darkvision Visor

Data Chip.description: A data chip contains enough memory for a religious text, photo album, personal journal, or the like. You can view the information on a data chip with a computer, such as the one in your comm unit.
Data Chip.name: Data Chip

Datajack (Advanced).description:
This cybernetic is a programmable data port installed into your body, allowing you to access computers and digital storage devices. Any handheld computer can connect to the port, while larger systems typically require an adapter cable. You don't need an interface to access the system, as it connects directly to your nervous system via the datajack. You must still attempt any skill checks associated with operating the device, such as Computers to access a system. Some closed systems don't allow direct data access at all.

You gain a +2 item bonus to Computers checks when accessing a system with an advanced datajack.
Datajack (Advanced).name: Datajack (Advanced)

Datapad.description: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
Datapad.name: Datapad

Defiance Series.description:
Upgrades: 1

This squad armor is a molded shell of reinforced polycarbon with a helmet and retractable visor.
Defiance Series.name: Defiance Series

Deflecting Field.description: This shield isn't held—instead, it's installed as an armor or weapon upgrade. A deflecting field appears as a translucent panel integrated into the upgraded item and creates a temporary protective hardlight barrier when activated.
Deflecting Field.name: Deflecting Field

Defrex Hide.description:
Upgrades: 1

Made from the hide of a ferocious mammal native to Vesk-2, this medium armor is especially popular among vesk. Tanned slabs of the creature's thick hide are stitched together with metal wires, and the joints are reinforced with metal studs or scales.
Defrex Hide.name: Defrex Hide

Degradation Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1d6[persistent,acid]] damage

Degradation grenades create violent blasts of magic that rip matter into different realities, leaving behind blackened hunks of matter that dissipate into nothingness. When the grenade explodes, it deals 3d8 acid damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
Degradation Grenade (Advanced).name: Degradation Grenade (Advanced)

Degradation Grenade (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1[persistent,acid]] damage

Degradation grenades create violent blasts of magic that rip matter into different realities, leaving behind blackened hunks of matter that dissipate into nothingness. When the grenade explodes, it deals 1d8 acid damage in a @Template[burst|distance:5] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.

Dermal Plating (Advanced).description: Hardened plates protect your skin and help you deflect physical blows. A limb with dermal plating functions as a shield. You can Raise a Shield with your limb, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use. You can use the Shield Block reaction with your limb. Dermal plating has Hardness 15. After you use Shield Block, your dermal plating becomes damaged and can't be used for 24 hours as the nanites repair the durable plates.
Dermal Plating (Advanced).name: Dermal Plating (Advanced)

Despair Crystal.description:
Created from the concentrated psychic echoes of anguish and pain, a despair crystal is a fist-sized, red gem.

Activate—Crack Crystal 1 (manipulate)

Effect You crack the despair crystal open, causing it to release its pent-up pain at a single target within 60 feet. The target is dealt @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19|basic|options:inflicts:stupefied] save. On a failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (for 1 minute on a critical failure).
Despair Crystal.name: Despair Crystal

Disintegration Lash.description:
Upgrades: 1

Appearing as an undulating black snake when powered, this whip crackles with red-tinged energy that sunders whatever it strikes at the atomic level.
Disintegration Lash.name: Disintegration Lash

Diva's Microphone (Advanced).description:
This ostentatious crystal microphone is embellished with glimmering jewels and delicate lights that pulse in time to music. It functions as both a microphone and speaker, amplifying your voice loud enough for you to be heard clearly by all listeners up to 500 feet away, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. This doesn't increase the range or area of other auditory or linguistic effects, and physical barriers such as walls still block or muffle your voice as normal.

The diva's microphone grants a +3 item bonus to Performance checks attempted with it.

Activate—Grand Finale 2 (auditory)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Your song reaches an eardrum-bursting climax as you cast a 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.QpP30fcEl4NGjHwo]{Sonic Scream} originating from your space (DC 38).
Diva's Microphone (Advanced).name: Diva's Microphone (Advanced)

Divinity Jammer.description: This magitech weapon upgrade is designed to muddle the mind and strain a target's connection to the divine. On a critical hit with the weapon, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn. If the target is a celestial, fiend, monitor, or creature with divine spells or abilities, it becomes stupefied 1 for 3 rounds instead.
Divinity Jammer.name: Divinity Jammer

Dizzying Anesthetic.description:
Activate 2 (manipulate)

Pulled from the internal reserves of a nodocite experimenter and concentrated into a more potent form, this poison causes intense dizziness in those infected, which in turn induces clumsiness and fatigue.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:15]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, clumsy 1, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 round)
Dizzying Anesthetic.name: Dizzying Anesthetic

Dogslicer.description:
Upgrades: 1

Goblins cherish ancestral melee weapons called dogslicers and horsechoppers, but most people don't understand why. Goblin weapons are easy to make but prone to breakage.
Dogslicer.name: Dogslicer

Doorkicker Datamine (Advanced).description:
When the autohack program is active, the UI on this datamine features an 8-bit lockpicking minigame that can be played while the program Hacks particularly complex locks. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to open, close, lock, or unlock a door.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine quickly attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB]{Hack} a door's computer to open, close, lock, or unlock the door. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the door with a +16 modifier and expert skill proficiency.

Upgrades: 1

The traditional weapon of the Veskarium, this powered poleaxe features one to three triangular blades forged for both wide overhead swings and tactical parrying.
Doshko.name: Doshko

Dragon Gland (Advanced).description:
With cutting edge surgery, you're implanted with an magical gland modified to function for a creature of your ancestry at the back of your throat. Choose your breath weapon's damage type when the organ is biocrafted from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the following activation.

Activate—Exhale 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] takes @Damage[(4d6)[untyped]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save. The damage depends on the augmentation's version.

Dragonsight Flashlight.description:
The latest innovation from Frozen Trove Labs is a tactical flashlight with special filters which can be activated to locate hidden objects.

Activate—Enhancement Filter 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect All creatures gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to locate hidden things in the area of the dragonsight flashlight's light, such as hidden traps and secret doors, for 30 minutes.
Dragonsight Flashlight.name: Dragonsight Flashlight

Dreamlink Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A glossy purple syrup swirled with streaks of black and green. After drinking this serum, your mind drifts and latches onto psychic impressions from the Newborn, granting you esoteric knowledge and alien wisdom at the expense of your current awareness. You gain a +2 item bonus to Occultism and Religion checks for 10 minutes. Once during the duration, you can roll a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} twice and use the better result (this is a fortune effect); if you roll a 1 or a 20 twice using this fortune effect, you glimpse the silhouette of a mysterious figure in the corner of your eye and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
Dreamlink Serum.name: Dreamlink Serum

Dueling Sword.description:
Upgrades: 1

Coming in a variety of styles, these traditional and time-tested weapons have been honed with advanced smithing techniques and modern materials.
Dueling Sword.name: Dueling Sword

Duo-Enhancers.description:
This magitech interface is a sophisticated pair of linked bracers, wristbands, gloves, or other garments suitable to the part of a creature's anatomy it uses to wield weapons. One of the paired enhancers includes a screen that displays data about the weapons the wearer is wielding, and the other enhancer contains magical crystals. When you wield a weapon in the hand wearing the display, the weapon's grade (such as tactical) is replicated onto the weapon you're wielding in the hand with the crystal enhancer, but only for purposes of determining the weapon's extra damage dice and tracking trait (which adds an item bonus to attack rolls). Any other properties of the weapon, such as its damage type, ammo, or upgrades, aren't replicated.

The replication functions only if you wear both enhancers, and it ends as soon as you cease wielding a weapon in one of your hands. Consequently, the benefit doesn't apply to thrown attacks or if you're holding a weapon but not wielding it (such as holding in one hand a weapon that requires two hands to wield, or holding a weapon in non-active hands).
Duo-Enhancers.name: Duo-Enhancers

Dupestick (Advanced).description:
Dupesticks are illegally modified credsticks whose value can be changed by Hacking them as a 1-minute activity. Recognizing this dupestick is fake requires a successful @Check[computers|dc:30] check or @Check[perception|dc:38] check.

This dupestick can store real credits on it, but attempting to withdraw more credits than are stored on it results in an error that automatically exposes the true nature of the dupestick.

In addition to storing real credits on it, you can switch the amount displayed on this dupestick to the actual number of credits on it as an Interact action.
Dupestick (Advanced).name: Dupestick (Advanced)

Dupestick (Commercial).description: Dupesticks are illegally modified credsticks whose value can be changed by Hacking them as a 1-minute activity. Recognizing that they are fake requires a successful @Check[computers|dc:15] check or @Check[perception|dc:18] check. Depositing or withdrawing credits from a dupestick to any other credstick results in an error that automatically exposes the true nature of the dupestick.
Dupestick (Commercial).name: Dupestick (Commercial)

Dupestick (Superior).description:
Dupesticks are illegally modified credsticks whose value can be changed by Hacking them as a 1-minute activity. Recognizing this dupestick is fake requires a successful @Check[computers|dc:40] check or @Check[perception|dc:48] check.

This dupestick can store real credits on it, but attempting to withdraw more credits than are stored on it results in an error that automatically exposes the true nature of the dupestick.

In addition to storing real credits on it, you can switch the amount displayed on this dupestick to the actual number of credits on it as an Interact action.

It takes 1 minute for an error message to appear when transferring credits, as if the transfer was being delayed due to a technical glitch. No error will display if the dupestick is physically removed before the error message is displayed.
Dupestick (Superior).name: Dupestick (Superior)

Dupestick (Tactical).description:

Electroencephalon.description:
This magical matrix records the consciousness, thoughts, and soul of a necrovite and also grants a limited form of telepathy. Such augmented psychic awareness is key to the process of preserving a necrovite's memories when their body is destroyed, including memories of whatever caused their destruction.

When a necrovite is destroyed, electroencephalon begins rebuilding their their physical form over the next 1d10 days. Not even disintegrating a necrovite's corpse can fully destroy the creature. The necrovite's new body manifests next to the electroencephalon, fully healed but without any equipment from their old body.

A standard electroencephalon is a piece of complex magitech about the size of a comm unit that has been constructed via occult means. This device typically has Hardness 10 and 40 HP.
Electroencephalon.name: Electroencephalon

Emergency Beacon.description: This item requires a battery to be installed for it to operate. When activated, this small, pod-shaped device transmits its location and emits a flash of bright red light once per round, consuming 1 charge per day. Any device capable of receiving signals can pick up a signal from an emergency beacon, which can then be traced with a successful @Check[computers|dc:15] or @Check[survival|dc:15] check. An emergency beacon's transmissions have a range of 100 miles over flat terrain, 50 miles in forests or hills, and 25 miles in mountainous terrain or underwater. Alternatively, an emergency beacon can be installed in a starship's or vehicle's communications system. In this case, its range is equal to that of the communications array, and it consumes 1 charge per hour.
Emergency Beacon.name: Emergency Beacon

Energy Shielding (Advanced).description: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 15 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.
Energy Shielding (Advanced).name: Energy Shielding (Advanced)

Energy Shielding (Commercial).description: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

Energy Shielding (Tactical).name: Energy Shielding (Tactical)

Entropic Destabilizer (Commercial).description: Tendrils of dark energy soar from the unit affixed to this weapon, coating it and its ammunition in a disturbing purple hue. When you hit with the weapon, add 1d4 void damage to the damage dealt. In addition, on a critical hit, the target takes 2d4 persistent void damage; if the target has a shield raised, the shield takes the same amount of persistent damage (its wielder rolls the flat check to see if the persistent damage ends, or the GM rolls if the shield is no longer in someone's possession). Unlike normal void damage, the void damage from an entropic destabilizer damages objects, constructs, and the like by eroding them away.
Entropic Destabilizer (Commercial).name: Entropic Destabilizer (Commercial)

Entropic Destabilizer (Tactical).description:
Tendrils of dark energy soar from the unit affixed to this weapon, coating it and its ammunition in a disturbing purple hue. When you hit with the weapon, add 1d4 void damage to the damage dealt. In addition, on a critical hit, the target takes 4d4 persistent void damage; if the target has a shield raised, the shield takes the same amount of persistent damage (its wielder rolls the flat check to see if the persistent damage ends, or the GM rolls if the shield is no longer in someone's possession). Unlike normal void damage, the void damage from an entropic destabilizer damages objects, constructs, and the like by eroding them away.

The void damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's void resistance or immunity.
Entropic Destabilizer (Tactical).name: Entropic Destabilizer (Tactical)

Upgrades: 1

Explorer's Canteen.description:
This thermos has two compartments. The upper compartment contains nanomachines and filters that target common contaminants, making most food and water safe to consume and granting a +1 item bonus to saves against any poisons or diseases present in the food or water. The lower compartment converts inserted UPBs into edible nutri-paste at a rate of 2 UPBs per 1 day of nourishment.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.52tyG1y50LmTqCA9]{Effect: Explorer's Canteen}
Explorer's Canteen.name: Explorer's Canteen

Explosive Defense Unit.description:
Reinforced custom armor plates automatically generate a containment field to protect you from nearby explosions, granting you resistance 2 to area damage (acid, cold, electricity, and fire damage only). You can also store a grenade in the explosive defense unit and detonate it without harming yourself.

Activate—Store Grenade 2 (manipulate)

Effect You place a grenade inside a reinforced compartment in the explosive defense unit. You can Interact to retrieve the grenade normally. You can store only one grenade in the armor upgrade at a time.

Activate—Defensive Detonation 1 (manipulate)

Requirements You have a stored grenade

Effect You detonate the grenade stored in the explosive defense unit. The explosion is centered on your space, but the upgrade generates a containment field to protect you from its effects. The grenade otherwise functions as if you'd activated it normally.
Explosive Defense Unit.name: Explosive Defense Unit

Eyeswide Trench Coat.description:
Upgrades: 2

This tactical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.mkMWda6ivlhnXq4d]{Armored Coat} is both fashionable and practical. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to [[/act sneak]] and [[/act hide]] in urban environments.

Activate—Distracting Double A (concentrate, illusion, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You swirl the bottom hem of the trench coat, which creates a temporary illusory double of you in your space. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with a +2 item bonus to your Deception check. You then Sneak. The DC to disbelieve the illusory double is 20, and the illusion lasts 1 minute.
Eyeswide Trench Coat.name: Eyeswide Trench Coat

Fangblade.description:
Upgrades: 1

Durable teeth line the edges of this motorized sword and spin with the force of an industrial chainsaw.
Fangblade.name: Fangblade

Fear Projector (Commercial).description: This integrated hologram projector makes the wounds caused by the weapon look way worse than they are. When you critically hit with this weapon, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Force Field (Advanced).description:
Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If you have a shield raised, your force field and shield both take damage. If damage from an attack or effect reduces the force field to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the force field deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Force fields replenish the indicated number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of your turn while they're active.

If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

The force field has 20 Hit Points and replenishes 4 Hit Points on your turn, and @Check[flat|dc:19].

Freebooter Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.
Freebooter Armor.name: Freebooter Armor

Frost Module (Commercial).description: This module siphons the heat from the weapon's striking edge and ammunition, powering itself with the excess energy as it chills the air around it. It deals an additional 1d6 cold damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:24] save.
Frost Module (Commercial).name: Frost Module (Commercial)

Frost Module (Tactical).description:
This module siphons the heat from the weapon's striking edge and ammunition, powering itself with the excess energy as it chills the air around it. It deals an additional 1d6 cold damage on a successful Strike. On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:34] save.

Cold damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's cold resistance.
Frost Module (Tactical).name: Frost Module (Tactical)

Functionary's Mask.description:
This angular half-mask is crafted from an unknown metal alloy with a steely gray sheen. From its four glowing eyespots to its pointed horns, the mask's appearance is harsh and synthetic. Despite covering the entire top half of the face, the Functionary's mask doesn't hinder vision or other senses. While wearing the Functionary's mask, you have darkvision and can communicate wirelessly with robots within 60 feet.

Activate—Override 2 (command, concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} (@Check[will|dc:19|traits:auditory,concentrate,linguistic,manipulate,mental|options:item:spell]) on a creature with the tech trait, ignoring any immunity it may have to mental effects.
Functionary's Mask.name: Functionary's Mask

Ghost Cloak (Commercial).description: This hooded cloak projects a small obscuring shadow across its wearer's body, using an optical weave that shines and shifts hues when viewed from the right angle. Items of Bulk up to L gain the concealable trait while stowed or worn under the cloak. The wearer can use an Interact action to pull the hood up or down, covering the wearer's head and face to obscure their identity.
Ghost Cloak (Commercial).name: Ghost Cloak (Commercial)

Ghost Cloak (Tactical).description: This hooded cloak projects a small obscuring shadow across its wearer's body, using an optical weave that shines and shifts hues when viewed from the right angle. Items of Bulk up to 1 gain the concealable trait while stowed or worn under the cloak. The wearer can use an Interact action to pull the hood up or down, covering the wearer's head and face to obscure their identity.
Ghost Cloak (Tactical).name: Ghost Cloak (Tactical)

Ghost Killer.description: This upgrade lets you harm creatures without physical form. A ghost killer weapon is particularly effective against incorporeal creatures, which almost always have a specific vulnerability to ghost killer weapons. Incorporeal creatures can touch, hold, and wield ghost killer weapons (unlike most physical objects).
Ghost Killer.name: Ghost Killer

Ghost's Harness (Advanced).description: This harness fits over your armor and is fitted with plenty of null-space pockets that enable you to carry numerous items that otherwise might weigh you down. This magically empowered harness increases the amount of Bulk its wearer can carry before being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and its maximum carried Bulk by 4.
Ghost's Harness (Advanced).name: Ghost's Harness (Advanced)

Gill Sheath.description: Oxygen-filtering nodules line the outside of your lungs. If you breathe in water, the gill sheath filters the oxygen into your lungs. This allows you to breathe underwater or in the air. You exhale normally.
Gill Sheath.name: Gill Sheath

Glamer Projector.description:
Adjustable rings project magical holograms onto your armor, changing its appearance to match your personal style and suit any occasion. Glamer projectors come programmed with preset options, including casual, corporate, and fashion. You can customize your glamer projector using a computer, like the one in your comm unit.

Activate—Glamerize! 1 (manipulate)

Effect You instantly change the appearance of your armor to any set of normal clothes or any other type of light or heavy armor. This upgrade is capable of changing only the appearance of your armor, not yourself or the rest of your equipment. You can copy the look of any type of clothing, but you don't gain any item bonuses provided by special types of clothing, such as luxury fashion attire. Only a creature that's benefiting from truesight or a similar effect can attempt to disbelieve this illusion, opposed by your class DC.
Glamer Projector.name: Glamer Projector

Glarecaster.description: Mimicking the glare of sunlight on ice, a glarecaster creates a blinding flash when fired. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
Glarecaster.name: Glarecaster

Glow Up Spell Amp (Advanced).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.V1cojmrEOWkJ1yPF]{Glow Up} spell
Glow Up Spell Amp (Advanced).name: Glow Up Spell Amp (Advanced)

On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.
Gluon Crystal (Advanced).name: Gluon Crystal (Advanced)

Gnarefuroid Carapace.description: Your carapace grants a +3 item bonus to AC and has a Dex cap of +2, a check penalty of –2, a Strength threshold of +2, and one upgrade slot. You can never wear other armor or remove your carapace. This carapace has the analog and comfort traits, and it can be improved by spending credits as if it were normal armor. Your carapace is medium armor in the ceramic group for abilities and for installing upgrades.
Gnarefuroid Carapace.name: Gnarefuroid Carapace

Graviton Crystal (Commercial).description: A graviton crystal increases the forces of gravity around your solar manifestations, accelerating its impact and possibly trapping foes within its gravity field. While graviton attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of your solar weapon's or flare's damage type. On a critical hit while you're graviton attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn.
Graviton Crystal (Commercial).name: Graviton Crystal (Commercial)

Graviton Crystal (Tactical).description:
A graviton crystal increases the forces of gravity around your solar manifestations, accelerating its impact and possibly trapping foes within its gravity field. While graviton attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[untyped]] damage of your solar weapon's or flare's damage type. On a critical hit while you're graviton attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 2 rounds.

Additionally, when you hit an immobilized or suppressed creature with your solar weapon or solar flare, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save or be knocked prone.
Graviton Crystal (Tactical).name: Graviton Crystal (Tactical)

Great Absalom Relay Medal.description: This medal marks you as the winner of The Great Absalom Relay, and the embedded data drive contains a full recording of the event broadcast. Hardlight Handwraps (Advanced).description:
Upgrades 2

These handwraps can be customized to shine in any color in the visible spectrum when used, and some manufacturers offer custom firmware that modifies their appearance to manifest as a claw, oversized fist, or hammerhead. They can even be worn in alternate ways on other parts of the body. These handwraps enhance your unarmed attacks as if they were manufactured weapons, allowing you to add an upgrade to your unarmed attacks. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons in the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes.

Your unarmed attacks gain the tracking +1 trait and increase the damage to two dice.
Hardlight Handwraps (Advanced).name: Hardlight Handwraps (Advanced)
