Hardlight Series.description:
Upgrades: 1

A projector fastened to a belt or lapel encases the wearer's body in this shimmering hardlight shell. Military-issue hardlight armor follows a predictable standard, but private users enjoy a range of customizable fashion options.
Hardlight Series.name: Hardlight Series

Haste Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} spell
Haste Spell Amp.name: Haste Spell Amp

Hearing Aid.description: This device fits into your ear canal or other suitable auditory organs. Commonly available at UPB printing kiosks, this augmentation restores or enhances hearing. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Hearing Aid.name: Hearing Aid

Hellforged Plates.description:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.heritages.Item.fq0LdrPloPz63YBh]{Hellforged Android}.

Hellforged plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +5 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +0, a check penalty of –3, a Speed penalty of –10 feet, and a Strength value of +3. They have the comfort trait, and you're trained in your Hellforged plates. You can never wear other armor or remove your Hellforged plates. You can etch armor runes onto Hellforged plates.
Hellforged Plates.name: Hellforged Plates

Hidden Soldier Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

This suit of heavy armor features a slitted helmet that reveals only the wearer's eyes. This high-tech ceramic suit consists of breastplate, shoulder guards, bracers, and greaves that flex with the body's movements.
Hidden Soldier Armor.name: Hidden Soldier Armor

Hideaway Limb (Commercial).description:
You can conceal items inside a hidden compartment in one of your limbs (such as an arm, leg, or tail) and protect them with a passcode. The compartment holds items of negligible Bulk and items of light Bulk that are small enough to fit in your limb or can otherwise be folded or contracted to fit. A hideaway in a leg (in a human) can typically hold more than one in an arm, and your size also adjusts the capacity at the GM's discretion.

When the compartment is closed, the seam in your limb is difficult to detect. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal an Object in a hideaway limb. Though this compartment can foil a cursory pat down, many security checkpoints include a scan to detect such devices.

Activate—Draw 1 (manipulate)

Effect You Interact to draw an item @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} in your hideaway limb.
Hideaway Limb (Commercial).name: Hideaway Limb (Commercial)

Hideaway Limb (Tactical).description:
You can conceal items inside a hidden compartment in one of your limbs (such as an arm, leg, or tail) and protect them with a passcode. The compartment holds items of negligible Bulk and items of light Bulk that are small enough to fit in your limb or can otherwise be folded or contracted to fit. A hideaway in a leg (in a human) can typically hold more than one in an arm, and your size also adjusts the capacity at the GM's discretion.

When the compartment is closed, the seam in your limb is difficult to detect. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal an Object in a hideaway limb. Though this compartment can foil a cursory pat down, many security checkpoints include a scan to detect such devices.

Activate—Draw 1 (manipulate)

Effect You Interact to draw an item @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} in your hideaway limb.

When you use Draw, if the item can be activated or otherwise used with a single action, you can use the item as part of the same action. For example, you Interact to draw a weapon, then Strike with that weapon.
Hideaway Limb (Tactical).name: Hideaway Limb (Tactical)

Holoskin (Commercial).description: A holographic projector mounted to a belt or limb strap can be activated as an Interact action. It can be programmed to project the appearance of another creature of the same size category as yourself, hiding your true appearance. A holoskin doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. You usually need a holoskin to set up a disguise in order to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone using the Deception skill.
Holoskin (Commercial).name: Holoskin (Commercial)

Holoskin (Tactical).description: A holographic projector mounted to a belt or limb strap can be activated as an Interact action. It can be programmed to project the appearance of another creature of the same size category as yourself, hiding your true appearance. A holoskin doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. You usually need a holoskin to set up a disguise in order to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone using the Deception skill. A tactical holoskin adds a +1 item bonus to relevant checks.
Holoskin (Tactical).name: Holoskin (Tactical)

Holospark.description: This tiny holoprojector is often disguised as an earring, lapel pin, or pendant, It stores a simple visual projection of personal flair, such as a halo or wings, accompanied by short audio, such as a clip of a popular song or a sound effect. Your holospark can be programmed with a computer, such as the one in your comm unit.
Holospark.name: Holospark

Holy Module (Commercial).description: This upgrade is often adorned with a religious symbol and channels celestial power. It deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage, or 3d4 spirit against an unholy target. If you are unholy, you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} while carrying or wielding this weapon. On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} (or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} if unholy) until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save.
Holy Module (Commercial).name: Holy Module (Commercial)

Holy Module (Tactical).description: This upgrade is often adorned with a religious symbol and channels celestial power. It deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage, or 3d4 spirit against an unholy target. If you are unholy, you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} while carrying or wielding this weapon. Holy Module (Tactical).name: Holy Module (Tactical)

Homespun Hat.description:
This pink, knit cap with a pom pom on top is hand crafted from fur-spun yarn and a mother's love. It's faded, fraying, and the opposite of stylish. Wearing this hat tells people you're not scared of anything.

Activate—Nevertheless, Persist 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per round

Requirements You have the frightened condition

Effect As part of the activation, you denounce the source of your fear and oppression. You and each ally in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] reduce your frightened values by 1.
Homespun Hat.name: Homespun Hat

Hook Claws (Commercial).description: Sharp synthetic claws extend your limbs, often appearing as extra-long nail tips made of precious metals and gems. You gain an unarmed claw attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits, and is in the brawling weapon group. Additionally, you gain a climb Speed of 15 feet. If you already have a climb Speed of 15 feet or more, you instead gain a +5-foot item bonus to your climb Speed.
Hook Claws (Commercial).name: Hook Claws (Commercial)

Hook Claws (Tactical).description: Sharp synthetic claws extend your limbs, often appearing as extra-long nail tips made of precious metals and gems. You gain an unarmed claw attack that deals 1d6 slashing damage, has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits, and is in the brawling weapon group. Additionally, you gain a climb Speed of 20 feet. If you already have a climb Speed of 20 feet or more, your climb Speed is instead equal to your land Speed if it’s higher.
Hook Claws (Tactical).name: Hook Claws (Tactical)

Horsechopper.description:
Upgrades: 1

Goblins cherish ancestral melee weapons called dogslicers and horsechoppers, but most people don't understand why. Goblin weapons are easy to make but prone to breakage.
Horsechopper.name: Horsechopper

Hoverzooms.description:
Hoverzooms miniaturize hoverbike technology and attach to the bottom of any pair of shoes (or similar attire and appendages), providing extra momentum on sudden movements. You gain a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks. When activated, a pair of wheel-like magnetic resonance devices extend from the shoes and propel the wearer off the ground.

Activate—Zoom Zoom 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You push away from the ground and immediately Step. For 1 minute you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed and your land Speed gains the hover trait.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.kUSHgMCK1Uvyhkx0]{Effect: Hoverzooms}
Hoverzooms.name: Hoverzooms

Hygiene Kit.description: This kit contains all the tools and products needed to practice good grooming and hygiene. Kits designed for specific creatures include supplies (such as scale-care products for vesk or antennae grooming oil for lashuntas or shirrens) that are of less use to other creatures.
Hygiene Kit.name: Hygiene Kit

Hypernerves.description:
This augmentation enhances your muscles and nervous system to dramatically improve your flexibility and reaction time. You gain a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Dexterity modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Engage Hypernerves f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger One of your reactions triggers, but you have no remaining reactions to spend

Effect You gain a reaction and immediately use the triggering reaction. You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} on your following turn.
Hypernerves.name: Hypernerves

  • Remove the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} condition
  • Decrease the value of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition by 1.

Incendiary Grenade (Advanced).description:

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 3d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:10]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.

Activate 1 (manipulate)

This oily serum grants a +1 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} for 10 minutes.

Infiltrator Serum.name: Infiltrator Serum

Infiltrator's Toolkit (Commercial).description: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill.
Infiltrator's Toolkit (Commercial).name: Infiltrator's Toolkit (Commercial)

Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical).description: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. A tactical infiltrator's toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks or Disable Devices.
Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical).name: Infiltrator's Toolkit (Tactical)

Infinity Deck.description: A replica of an artifact that appeared during the Gap, this deck of playing cards is used to play countless games.
Infinity Deck.name: Infinity Deck

Intercepting Ears (Commercial).description:
Microscopic psychoactive crystals embedded in your eardrums resonate at similar frequencies as telepathic messages. They vibrate slightly whenever a creature within 30 feet of you sends or receives a message via limited telepathy.

Activate—Psychic TapR (concentrate, linguistic, mental)

Trigger Your intercepting ears alert you to a telepathic message being sent or received

Requirements You understand the language used in the message

Effect You concentrate to adjust the frequency of your crystals to overhear the message. The triggering creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:18] save. On a failure, you also hear the message.
Intercepting Ears (Commercial).name: Intercepting Ears (Commercial)

Intercepting Ears (Tactical).description:
Microscopic psychoactive crystals embedded in your eardrums resonate at similar frequencies as telepathic messages. They vibrate slightly whenever a creature within 30 feet of you sends or receives a message via limited telepathy or telepathy (including through the use of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.HqTI6wRrck1YXp3F]{Telepathy} spell).

Activate—Psychic TapR (concentrate, linguistic, mental)

Trigger Your intercepting ears alert you to a telepathic message being sent or received

Requirements You understand the language used in the message

Effect You concentrate to adjust the frequency of your crystals to overhear the message. The triggering creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:26] save. On a failure, you also hear the message.
Intercepting Ears (Tactical).name: Intercepting Ears (Tactical)

Invisibility Potion.description:
Activate A (manipulate)

An invisibility potion is colorless and oddly lightweight. Upon drinking it, you gain the effects of a 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell.
Invisibility Potion.name: Invisibility Potion

Invisibility Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell
Invisibility Spell Amp.name: Invisibility Spell Amp

Iovan Ammunition.description:
Ammunition projectile

Harvested from the Diaspora by Ulrikka Clanholdings, these rocks contain charged particles from the Astral Plane. When forged in a process that is part flint-knapping and part occult communion, skilled artificers can turn shards of these rocks into ammunition capable of harming incorporeal beings. Each piece of Iovan ammunition functions as though the weapon firing it had the ghost killer weapon upgrade. The brittle ammunition deals 0 damage against corporeal targets, as it breaks apart upon impact. Iovan ammunition deals half damage (rounded down) to an incorporeal creature possessing a living creature, making it popular with exorcists throughout the galaxy.
Iovan Ammunition.name: Iovan Ammunition

Iridescent Baton.description:
The prepared interstellar performer keeps contingencies close to hand to distract or deter rowdy crowds, aggressive autograph seekers, and stage invaders. The discrete iridescent baton has a flexible nanotech nozzle that creates mundane but entertaining floating soap bubbles of any shape, including not just geometric solids like cubes, pyramids, and dodecahedrons, but also figures like animals and dragons! The iridescent baton grants a +1 item bonus to Performance checks made while incorporating it into your routine.

Activate—Ephemeral Creation 2 (manipulate, water)

You create a piece of bubble art in a 5-foot cube adjacent to you that lasts for 1 round and provides lesser cover. You can then [[/act create-a-diversion]] as part of this activation. If a creature interacts with the bubble art in any way, it pops, ending the effect.

Activate—Containment Bubble2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You attempt to trap a Large or smaller creature within 30 feet in a sturdy bubble. The creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20] Save. On a failure, they become trapped in a translucent bubble that blocks attacks, effects, and creatures that would pass through it, including the target; line of sight is unaffected. The bubble has AC 17, @Damage[30[healing]] Hit Points, and weakness 5 to piercing and slashing damage, and lasts until destroyed.
Iridescent Baton.name: Iridescent Baton

Irising Shield.description: An irising shield is made of flexible polycarbon with a retractable design. When retracted, an irising shield looks like a decorative bangle, gauntlet, or glove. When deployed, its panels flare out and form a miniature circular shield.
Irising Shield.name: Irising Shield

Ivory Chompers.description: Tiny pneumatic pistons hidden inside these ornate dental veneers turn them into deadly weapons. Pioneered by the undead media mogul Zo! for celebrities who need to stay armed and fashionable at all times, ivory chompers provide a last-ditch biting attack against attackers. Special designer versions incorporate custom monogrammed imprints, jewels, and metal plating for the ultimate smile.
Ivory Chompers.name: Ivory Chompers

Jetpack (Commercial).description:
Boosters attached to your armor allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.0kP4P73w0PykYkPY]{Effect: Jetpack}
Jetpack (Commercial).name: Jetpack (Commercial)

Jetpack (Tactical).description:
Boosters attached to your armor allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 40 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.0kP4P73w0PykYkPY]{Effect: Jetpack}
Jetpack (Tactical).name: Jetpack (Tactical)

Jump Jets.description:
Boosters attached to your armor supercharge your leap.

Activate—Jump 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per round

Effect You activate the jump jets to get a quick boost. You Fly up to 20 feet with a maximum height of 10 feet, or you Fly up to 20 feet straight up. You must land at the end of this movement or fall. Jump jets can't lift you if you're encumbered.
Jump Jets.name: Jump Jets

Jump Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Q7QQ91vQtyi1Ux36]{Jump} spell
Jump Spell Amp.name: Jump Spell Amp

Knife.description:
Upgrades: 1

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from starmetals to ceramics.
Knife.name: Knife

Kyokor Plating.description:
Upgrade: 1

This armor incorporates a full-coverage polycarbon suit studded with ports and sockets and layered with plates from Daimalko's infamous colossi. Kyokor plating comes with boots, gloves, and a helmet with a clear visor.
Kyokor Plating.name: Kyokor Plating

Laser Eye.description: A laser eye from an Akashic dragon (or other creature) has been implanted into your body. Whether the eye was vat grown or carved from a kill is your secret. You gain a laser eye unarmed attack that deals 1d4 fire damage with a range increment of 60 feet. Your laser eye is in the laser group and has the agile, concealable, fire, tech, and unarmed traits.
Laser Eye.name: Laser Eye

Laser Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.
Laser Pistol.name: Laser Pistol

Laser Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.
Laser Rifle.name: Laser Rifle

Liminal Laser Rifle.description:
There's a handmade magitech device attached to this @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.0TSUahGsoVnDZ6kv]{Laser Rifle}, consisting of a bracketed glowing gem and wires that connect the gem's carved glyphs to the rifle's firing mechanism.

Activate—Liminal Lock 1 Cost 2 charges

Effect The next time you make a ranged Strike against a target that's benefiting from cover, reduce their circumstance bonus to AC gained from cover by 1.

Special If you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aim}, you can Aim as part of the Liminal Lock action, and Aim reduces the target's bonus from cover by an additional 1.
Liminal Laser Rifle.name: Liminal Laser Rifle

Limscan Lenses.description: Functioning as a built-in @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.VqqxwnjFeCNmHSe0]{Limscanner}, sensors in your eyes are calibrated to detect fluctuations in planar energies found inside the Ghost Levels, allowing you to scan for certain anomalies during a limdive or while investigating oddities across the galaxy. You gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps, to AC against attacks made by magical traps, and to saves against magical traps. Even if you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you get a check to find magical traps that normally require you to be Searching. You cannot Disable traps without the otherwise required proficiency.
Limscan Lenses.name: Limscan Lenses

Limscanner.description: This magitech device is calibrated to detect fluctuations in planar energies found inside the Ghost Levels. While carrying this item, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps, to AC against attacks made by magical traps, and to saves against magical traps. Even if you aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching}, you get a check to find magical traps that normally requires you to be Searching. You cannot disable traps without the otherwise required proficiency.
Limscanner.name: Limscanner

Load Lifter (Advanced).description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 8 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 13 plus your Strength modifier.
Load Lifter (Advanced).name: Load Lifter (Advanced)

Load Lifter (Commercial).description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 6 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 11 plus your Strength modifier.
Load Lifter (Commercial).name: Load Lifter (Commercial)

Load Lifter (Tactical).description: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 7 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 12 plus your Strength modifier.
Load Lifter (Tactical).name: Load Lifter (Tactical)

Lock (Advanced).description: Picking an advanced lock requires four successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=25]]{DC 25 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Advanced).name: Lock (Advanced)

Lock (Commercial).description: Picking a commercial lock requires two successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=15]]{DC 15 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Commercial).name: Lock (Commercial)

Lock (Elite).description: Picking an elite lock requires six successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=40]]{DC 40 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Elite).name: Lock (Elite)

Lock (Superior).description: Picking a superior lock requires five successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=30]]{DC 30 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Superior).name: Lock (Superior)

Lock (Tactical).description: Picking a tactical lock requires two successful [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{DC 20 Thievery} checks.
Lock (Tactical).name: Lock (Tactical)

Loudener (Commercial).description: This specialized cone is installed over the muzzle or hilt of a weapon to use pneumonic pulses and passive acoustics to increase the volume of its attacks. It deals an extra 1d6 sonic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute (or 1 hour on a critical failure).
Loudener (Commercial).name: Loudener (Commercial)

Loudener (Tactical).description:
This specialized cone is installed over the muzzle or hilt of a weapon to use pneumonic pulses and passive acoustics to increase the volume of its attacks. It deals an extra 1d6 sonic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute (or 1 hour on a critical failure).

Sonic damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's sonic resistance.
Loudener (Tactical).name: Loudener (Tactical)

Machine Gun.description:
Upgrades: 1

These proven and reliable automatic weapons are capable of firing in short bursts or completely emptying their magazines to clear a battlefield.
Machine Gun.name: Machine Gun

Machine Mind Serum (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you inject this serum, magitech nanites infuse your body with machine-like circuitry that pulses and glows beneath your skin. For 1 hour, you gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You also gain resistance 15 to mental damage. Due to your more machine-like nature, you gain weakness 15 to electricity.
Machine Mind Serum (Advanced).name: Machine Mind Serum (Advanced)

Machine Mind Serum (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you inject this serum, magitech nanites infuse your body with machine-like circuitry that pulses and glows beneath your skin. For 1 minute, you gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You also gain resistance 5 to mental damage. Due to your more machine-like nature, you gain weakness 5 to electricity.
Machine Mind Serum (Commercial).name: Machine Mind Serum (Commercial)

Machine Mind Serum (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you inject this serum, magitech nanites infuse your body with machine-like circuitry that pulses and glows beneath your skin. For 10 minutes, you gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You also gain resistance 10 to mental damage. Due to your more machine-like nature, you gain weakness 10 to electricity.
Machine Mind Serum (Tactical).name: Machine Mind Serum (Tactical)

Magboots.description: Magboots can be activated or deactivated with an Interact action. While active, they grant you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb metal surfaces as well as a +1 item bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you when you're standing on a metal surface. In areas of zero gravity, while wearing a pair of magboots, you can move your Speed across metal surfaces and don't gain the untethered condition.
Magboots.name: Magboots

Magefoil Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Failure @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 2 rounds, then stupefied 1 for 2 rounds

These grenades discharge waves of psychic energy that deal mental damage with a @Check[will|against:class|basic] save.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:15], and the mental damage is 3d8.

Magnetar Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle uses powerful electromagnets to accelerate simple slugs into deadly, highly accurate projectiles without the use of any moving parts.
Magnetar Rifle.name: Magnetar Rifle

Maker's App.description: This comm unit app contains formulas for Crafting the common items in this section.
Maker's App.name: Maker's App

Maker's Toolkit (Commercial).description: You need a maker's toolkit to create items from UPBs with the Craft skill.
Maker's Toolkit (Commercial).name: Maker's Toolkit (Commercial)

Maker's Toolkit (Tactical).description: You need a maker's toolkit to create items from UPBs with the Craft skill. A tactical maker's toolkit gives you a +1 item bonus to the check.
Maker's Toolkit (Tactical).name: Maker's Toolkit (Tactical)

Maneuvering Unit (Advanced).description:
Internal stabilizers and jets synchronize your movements in zero gravity. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or clumsy while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}.

Activate—Thrust 1 (move)

Requirements You're in a zero-g environment

Effect You move 15 feet in any direction you choose. You begin to float in that direction.
Maneuvering Unit (Advanced).name: Maneuvering Unit (Advanced)

Maneuvering Unit (Commercial).description:
Internal stabilizers and jets synchronize your movements in zero gravity. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or clumsy while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}.

Internal stabilizers and jets synchronize your movements in zero gravity. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or clumsy while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}.

Activate—Thrust 1 (move)

Maneuvering Unit (Tactical).name: Maneuvering Unit (Tactical)

Maratan Headache (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}

Maratan headaches are made from brittle hollow gourds filled with a putrid sludge, dealing 3d8 nonlethal poison damage in a @Template[burst|distance:10] with a @Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save.
Maratan Headache (Advanced).name: Maratan Headache (Advanced)

Marrow Paste (Advanced).description: Developed and patented by Eoxian medical conglomerate Nulife, this magenta tincture's metallic odor is reminiscent of fresh blood. When applied to the body of a creature that can benefit from void healing, marrow paste grants fast healing 5 for 1 minute.
Marrow Paste (Advanced).name: Marrow Paste (Advanced)

Marrow Paste (Commercial).description: Developed and patented by Eoxian medical conglomerate Nulife, this magenta tincture's metallic odor is reminiscent of fresh blood. When applied to the body of a creature that can benefit from void healing, marrow paste grants fast healing 1 for 1 minute.
Marrow Paste (Commercial).name: Marrow Paste (Commercial)

Marrow Paste (Superior).description: Developed and patented by Eoxian medical conglomerate Nulife, this magenta tincture's metallic odor is reminiscent of fresh blood. When applied to the body of a creature that can benefit from void healing, marrow paste grants fast healing 10 for 1 minute.

Marrow Paste (Tactical).description: Developed and patented by Eoxian medical conglomerate Nulife, this magenta tincture's metallic odor is reminiscent of fresh blood. When applied to the body of a creature that can benefit from void healing, marrow paste grants fast healing 3 for 1 minute.
Marrow Paste (Tactical).name: Marrow Paste (Tactical)

Medkit (Commercial).description: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.
Medkit (Commercial).name: Medkit (Commercial)

Medkit (Tactical).description: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. Tactical medical toolkits provide a +1 item bonus to such checks. A medkit is a toolkit.
Medkit (Tactical).name: Medkit (Tactical)

Medpatch (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(5d6+12)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]{Effect: Medpatch}
Medpatch (Advanced).name: Medpatch (Advanced)

Medpatch (Commercial).description:

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]{Effect: Medpatch}

Medpatch (Elite).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(8d6+21)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]{Effect: Medpatch}

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(7d6+18)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]{Effect: Medpatch}
Medpatch (Superior).name: Medpatch (Superior)

Medpatch (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(3d6+6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]{Effect: Medpatch}
Medpatch (Tactical).name: Medpatch (Tactical)

Medpatch (Ultimate).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(10d6+27)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +4 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]{Effect: Medpatch}

Meme Cannon.description:
Upgrades 2

This weapon's actual name is the mesmeric-synaptic cannon, but it's been all but officially renamed to meme cannon. It fires bursts of sonic and visual gibberish designed to overload and overwhelm the senses of its targets. The so-called meme cannon weapon can be used to pacify even the toughest enemies of the Pact Worlds.
Meme Cannon.name: Meme Cannon

Merciful.description:
Merciful weapons are limned in a green glow recognized around the galaxy. A merciful weapon has the nonlethal trait and can't be used to make a lethal attack. Any persistent damage the weapon would deal is negated.

On a critical hit, a merciful weapon causes the target to become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the weapon's wielder for 1 minute, as the target is bombarded with feelings of guilt and remorse. This is a mental effect. If you have access to the weapon's critical specialization effect, you choose whether to use it or the merciful effect.
Merciful.name: Merciful

Miasmatic Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} from miasmatic grenade

This grenade is filled with nonlethal chemical compounds that emit a foul, noxious odor when released. Peacekeepers use these grenades to safely quell riots and hostage situations in crowded urban areas. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against miasmatic grenades are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:10], and on a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.
Miasmatic Grenade (Advanced).name: Miasmatic Grenade (Advanced)

Microcord Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

This light armor is woven from ultralight fibers that flex with a wearer's movements but turn hard as steel on impact.
Microcord Armor.name: Microcord Armor

Microgoggles.description: These bulky goggles include adjustable magnifying lenses and lights, granting you a +2 item bonus to any skill check that benefits from exceedingly close vision, such as detecting complicated forgeries, identifying pathogens in blood samples, or crafting drugs or medicinals.
Microgoggles.name: Microgoggles

Microphone.description: This cordless handheld device records and transmits audio, typically to a speaker or computer.
Microphone.name: Microphone

Mindshutter Stone.description:
This gleaming, cylindrical crystal hangs from a silver chain and repels psychic energy, shielding your mind from harm. You gain resistance 3 to mental damage.

Activate—Shutter Mind r (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect

Effect You shunt the harmful psychic energy into the mindshutter stone, gaining a success against the triggering effect instead. The mindshutter stone then goes dormant, losing all abilities until you next invest it.
Mindshutter Stone.name: Mindshutter Stone

Mobile Bulwark.description: This bulky shield is advertised as the ultimate protection in battle for those strong enough to hoist them. Mobile bulwarks create an iconic rectangular silhouette and are popular with heavily armored mercenaries and soldiers, notably among the Veskarium military and some orders of Hellknights. A mobile bulwark is often constructed of carbon steel, with a transparent aluminum view port.
Mobile Bulwark.name: Mobile Bulwark

Mobility Enhancer (Commercial).description: Automated braces help you to move faster in bulky armor. Reduce your armor's penalty to Speeds by 5 feet.
Mobility Enhancer (Commercial).name: Mobility Enhancer (Commercial)

Mobility Enhancer (Tactical).description: Automated braces help you to move faster in bulky armor. Reduce your armor's penalty to Speeds by 10 feet.
Mobility Enhancer (Tactical).name: Mobility Enhancer (Tactical)

Moodskin.description: Magically infused nanites injected into your skin automatically react to your mood by changing the pigmentation of your skin. The color change is gradual, typically taking at least 30 seconds to fully transition from one color to another. Moodskin can be customized to adjust which colors correspond to each mood during installation. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Moodskin.name: Moodskin

Multithreaded Carcanet.description:
The large jewels that make up this showy necklace are etched with intricate circuitry that activates when worn against the body. The circuits can take on some of a wearer's cognitive load, increasing the speed of their thoughts. The multithreaded carcanet makes your reasoning more efficient, granting you a +2 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Multitask Recall 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} twice. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them for these actions.
Multithreaded Carcanet.name: Multithreaded Carcanet

Muscle Invigorator.description:
This augmentation keeps your muscles in peak condition. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Strength of the Colossi 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You temporarily become as destructive and powerful as a colossus. For 1 hour, your melee Strikes ignore the hardness of all objects and structures not made of adamantine or a harder material.
Muscle Invigorator.name: Muscle Invigorator

Musical Instrument (Handheld, Commercial.description: All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Handheld instruments include autohorns, guitars, psychoactive wave plates, digital synth decks, holoflutes, and more. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument has greater Bulk. Some instruments have the tech trait.
Musical Instrument (Handheld, Commercial.name: Musical Instrument (Handheld, Commercial)

Musical Instrument (Handheld, Tactical).description:
All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Handheld instruments include autohorns, guitars, psychoactive wave plates, digital synth decks, holoflutes, and more. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument has greater Bulk. Some instruments have the tech trait.

A tactical instrument gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks using that instrument.
Musical Instrument (Handheld, Tactical).name: Musical Instrument (Handheld, Tactical)

Musical Instrument (Heavy, Commercial).description: All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Heavy instruments, such as drumdecks and theremins, are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played. Some instruments have the tech trait.
Musical Instrument (Heavy, Commercial).name: Musical Instrument (Heavy, Commercial)

Musical Instrument (Heavy, Tactical).description:
All but the most traditional instruments use modern technology to amplify their sound, provide musical accompaniment, or connect wirelessly to other instruments. Heavy instruments, such as drumdecks and theremins, are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played. Some instruments have the tech trait.

A tactical instrument gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks using that instrument.
Musical Instrument (Heavy, Tactical).name: Musical Instrument (Heavy, Tactical)

Nano-Optics Node.description:
A crystalline nanocarbon node implanted in your occipital lobe connects to optic nerves by microscopic fibers. You can activate the node to overlay your normal vision with X-ray data. You can deactivate the overlay as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Activate—X-Ray Overlay 1 (concentrate)

Effect Your nano-optics node relays collected X-ray data directly to your eyes, overlaying your normal vision. You can see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white. Due to the distracting amount of visual information, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks while the overlay is active.
Nano-Optics Node.name: Nano-Optics Node

Nano-edge Rapier.description:
Upgrades: 1

The edge of this precision-crafted foil is sharpened to the thickness of a single atom, using regenerating nanites to maintain itself after countless strikes.
Nano-edge Rapier.name: Nano-edge Rapier

Necrolung (Advanced).description:
Spongy black webbing radiates from a grayish purple mass of necrotized flesh that pulses when it's exposed to air. Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox, becoming effectively immune to the toxins in its atmosphere for an additional 24 hours per level, and you gain a +2 item bonus to saves against diseases and poisons.

Installing a necrolung takes one minute and requires no skill checks. When installed, a necrolung slithers down your throat (or appropriate alien anatomy) and integrates into your respiratory system. Most users notice a harmless pallor and rotting smell while using the tech.
Necrolung (Advanced).name: Necrolung (Advanced)

Necrolung (Commercial).description:
Spongy black webbing radiates from a grayish purple mass of necrotized flesh that pulses when it's exposed to air. Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox, becoming effectively immune to the toxins in its atmosphere for an additional 24 hours.

Installing a necrolung takes one minute and requires no skill checks. When installed, a necrolung slithers down your throat (or appropriate alien anatomy) and integrates into your respiratory system. Most users notice a harmless pallor and rotting smell while using the tech.
Necrolung (Commercial).name: Necrolung (Commercial)

Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox, becoming effectively immune to the toxins in its atmosphere for an additional 24 hours per level, and you gain a +3 item bonus to saves against diseases and poisons.

Installing a necrolung takes one minute and requires no skill checks. When installed, a necrolung slithers down your throat (or appropriate alien anatomy) and integrates into your respiratory system. Most users notice a harmless pallor and rotting smell while using the tech.
Necrolung (Superior).name: Necrolung (Superior)

Necrolung (Tactical).description:
Spongy black webbing radiates from a grayish purple mass of necrotized flesh that pulses when it's exposed to air. Specially grown in vats from waste produced in the necrograft manufacturing process, necrolungs allow living creatures to breathe efficiently and safely on Eox, becoming effectively immune to the toxins in its atmosphere for an additional 24 hours per level, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against diseases and poisons; this bonus increases to +2 if the effect is inhaled.

Installing a necrolung takes one minute and requires no skill checks. When installed, a necrolung slithers down your throat (or appropriate alien anatomy) and integrates into your respiratory system. Most users notice a harmless pallor and rotting smell while using the tech.
Necrolung (Tactical).name: Necrolung (Tactical)

Neural Dampener (Advanced).description:
Runic circuits are wired across the surface of your brain, providing protection against attempts to read your thoughts or otherwise attack your mind. You gain mental resistance 15.

Activate—Raise Mental Defenses 1 (concentrate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect Psychic energy surges across the dampener's circuitry, you gain +3 circumstance bonus to Will Saves and Will DCs against mental effects for 1 minute.
Neural Dampener (Advanced).name: Neural Dampener (Advanced)

Neural Dampener (Commercial).description:
Runic circuits are wired across the surface of your brain, providing protection against attempts to read your thoughts or otherwise attack your mind. You gain mental resistance 5.

Activate—Raise Mental Defenses 1 (concentrate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect Psychic energy surges across the dampener's circuitry, you gain +1 circumstance bonus to Will Saves and Will DCs against mental effects for 1 minute.
Neural Dampener (Commercial).name: Neural Dampener (Commercial)

Neural Dampener (Tactical).description:
Runic circuits are wired across the surface of your brain, providing protection against attempts to read your thoughts or otherwise attack your mind. You gain mental resistance 10.

Activate—Raise Mental Defenses 1 (concentrate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect Psychic energy surges across the dampener's circuitry, you gain +2 circumstance bonus to Will Saves and Will DCs against mental effects for 1 minute.
Neural Dampener (Tactical).name: Neural Dampener (Tactical)

Neural Lash.description:
Upgrades: 1

This whiplike tendril of electricity subtly responds to psychic signals. Telepaths who wield a properly calibrated neural lash treat it as an extension of their body.
Neural Lash.name: Neural Lash

Null Space Chamber (Advanced).description:
This sleek black device attaches to a backpack, purse, or key ring. When you press a button on the side of the device, it creates a circular portal to an extradimensional pocket space. The space's capacity depends on the device's type.

You can Interact with the null space chamber to stow items in it or remove them. The null space chamber can be opened and closed only from the outside. When a null space chamber is opened in an atmosphere with air, it fills with 10 minutes' worth of air for every Bulk left in its capacity. An item inside the null space chamber provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. Connecting the null space chamber to a computer causes it to display a readout of all items stored within it.

Capacity 100 Bulk
Null Space Chamber (Advanced).name: Null Space Chamber (Advanced)
