Null-Space Pocket.description: A null-space pocket allows the user to stow a single item of 2 Bulk or less into an extradimensional space. You cannot draw a weapon while it's in a null-space pocket, but you can use an Interact action to retrieve it. Creatures gain a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception checks and Perception DCs to notice if you have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Concealed an Object} in a worn null-space pocket.
Null-Space Pocket.name: Null-Space Pocket

Numbing Beam Pistol.description:
Upgrades 1

Originally designed during the Silent War, this technology is still deployed by Stewards in combat situations. The numbing beam pistol fires a single burst of cold energy in an attempt to freeze limbs or appendages.
Numbing Beam Pistol.name: Numbing Beam Pistol

Numbing Beam Rifle.description:
Upgrades 1

The numbing beam rifle was designed with the same technology used for numbing beam pistols but is calibrated to take down tougher foes. Numbing beam rifles are often deployed against burly threats so they can be properly apprehended.
Numbing Beam Rifle.name: Numbing Beam Rifle

Ossifying Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 2 rounds

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 3d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Advanced).name: Ossifying Grenade (Advanced)

Ossifying Grenade (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 1d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:5] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Commercial).name: Ossifying Grenade (Commercial)

Ossifying Grenade (Elite).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 10d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:15] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Elite).name: Ossifying Grenade (Elite)

Ossifying Grenade (Paragon).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 3}

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 14d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Paragon).name: Ossifying Grenade (Paragon)

Ossifying Grenade (Superior).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 8d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:15] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Superior).name: Ossifying Grenade (Superior)

Ossifying Grenade (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 2d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Tactical).name: Ossifying Grenade (Tactical)

Ossifying Grenade (Ultimate).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 12d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
Ossifying Grenade (Ultimate).name: Ossifying Grenade (Ultimate)

Pact Enforcer Armor.description: Carbon steel plate forms a protective cage around the wearer that can stand up to punishing damage.
Pact Enforcer Armor.name: Pact Enforcer Armor

Pact Keeper Armor.description: This standard issue full set of Steward armor has a simple, functional design with space for adornments and medals to be attached once earned.
Pact Keeper Armor.name: Pact Keeper Armor

Pact Observer Armor.description: This lightweight armor is often worn by medics, scouts, and team leaders. This model comes with an upgrade slot to allow for ease of usability and modification in the field as needed, as the Stewards recon squads never know what they're going to face.
Pact Observer Armor.name: Pact Observer Armor

Pain Journal (Commercial).description:
Your raw emotions empower the poems and phrases penned in this synthetic leather journal. After spending 1 day writing in your pain journal, select Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance. Once a skill is selected for a pain journal, it can't be changed. Reading directly from the journal harnesses your painful memories, projects your emotions, and gives you a +1 item bonus to checks using the selected skill.

Activate—Painful Memory 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You recite a poem of utter anguish to spread your misery to another creature, casting a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.EhN3GjdjXChMdiFk]{Share Pain} (DC 23).
Pain Journal (Commercial).name: Pain Journal (Commercial)

Pain Journal (Tactical).description:
Your raw emotions empower the poems and phrases penned in this synthetic leather journal. After spending 1 day writing in your pain journal, select Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance. Once a skill is selected for a pain journal, it can't be changed. Reading directly from the journal harnesses your painful memories, projects your emotions, and gives you a +2 item bonus to checks using the selected skill.

Activate—Painful Memory 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You recite a poem of utter anguish to spread your misery to another creature, casting a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.EhN3GjdjXChMdiFk]{Share Pain} (DC 34).
Pain Journal (Tactical).name: Pain Journal (Tactical)

Painglaive.description:
Upgrades: 1

This fierce but deceptively elegant polearm rips apart enemies with a motor-powered fangblade. An adjustable pulse trigger allows the wielder to channel extra pain through the weapon.
Painglaive.name: Painglaive

Parallel Accord.description:
A parallel accord is a small metallic disk ringed with magical runes that transcend reality, serving as a nexus for a number of your parallel selves. When invested, a parallel accord hovers over your head like a crown.

Activate—Parallel Positioning r (concentration, teleportation)

Trigger You succeed at a saving throw against a spell or a Strike misses you

Frequency once per day

Effect You tap into one of the alternate realities linked to your parallel accord, repositioning yourself into a location you occupy in another reality. You teleport to any unoccupied square you can see within 20 feet. If you critically succeeded at the triggering saving throw or were critically missed by the triggering Strike, you additionally become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the beginning of your next turn, as your body is shrouded in fragmented reflections of other realities.
Parallel Accord.name: Parallel Accord

Petrified Bark.description:
Note Petrified heritage only

Your body is covered in thick, plated bark. Your bark is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of 16, and has the bulwark, comfort, and exposed traits. You can never wear other armor or remove the bark. You can etch armor runes onto the bark.
Petrified Bark.name: Petrified Bark

Phase Cutlass.description:
Upgrades: 1

A phase cutlass resembles a traditional curved sword until it's powered. Then its blade morphs into a shimmering void, with a tiny star for each life it ended.
Phase Cutlass.name: Phase Cutlass

Phase Shield.description: A phase shield is an intricate but durable technological device often worn strapped to a limb or belt that projects a protective hardlight barrier when deployed. Phase shields are translucent and tinted, with a wide variety of fully customizable colors and image projectors. Many wielders choose an image of a favorite celebrity, loved one, or pleasant scenery to bolster their fighting spirit in a dire situation.
Phase Shield.name: Phase Shield

Photon Crystal (Commercial).description: A photon crystal increases the flow of photon into your solar manifestations, burning and blinding your foes. While photon attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage. On a critical hit while you're photon attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
Photon Crystal (Commercial).name: Photon Crystal (Commercial)

Photon Crystal (Tactical).description:
A photon crystal increases the flow of photon into your solar manifestations, burning and blinding your foes. While photon attuned, your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[fire]] damage. On a critical hit while you're photon attuned, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 2 rounds.

Damage dealt by your solar weapon or flare while photon attuned ignores the target's resistance to fire.
Photon Crystal (Tactical).name: Photon Crystal (Tactical)

Photosynthetic Skin.description: Specialized nanites enhance your natural surface cells, allowing them to convert solar radiation into nourishment for your body. You don't need to eat, and you're never @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} as a result of hunger or starvation as long as you spend at least 1 hour per day basking in direct sunlight. You can bask as part of a normal 8-hour rest period.
Photosynthetic Skin.name: Photosynthetic Skin

Plasma Cannon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This long-barreled weapon shoots charges of ionized gas that explode in a blast of superheated plasma.
Plasma Cannon.name: Plasma Cannon

Plasma Caster.description:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol shoots balls of condensed plasma. Holding down the trigger and safety clip at the same time before firing results in the barrel building up more plasma.
Plasma Caster.name: Plasma Caster

Plasma Doshko.description:
Upgrades: 1

Unlike a traditional doshko, this poleaxe uses blades of magnetically stabilized plasma that spin to cleave through multiple enemies with ease.
Plasma Doshko.name: Plasma Doshko

Plasma Sword.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sword generates a focused beam of plasma around a localized force field powered by a generator in the sword's hilt. The beam only blazes to life when the sword is powered.
Plasma Sword.name: Plasma Sword

Polyglove.description:
Upgrades: 1

This glove features dozens of delicate tools for building or repairing computers and other technological items, requiring an entire hand (or suitable appendage) to manipulate. Overclocking the polyglove's components generates voltage between a wielder's fingertips.
Polyglove.name: Polyglove

Portable Amp.description: This small device is typically synced up to an instrument, microphone, or the audio playback on a datapad. It amplifies the audio volume, reducing the DC of Perception checks to hear the audio by 5.
Portable Amp.name: Portable Amp

Pow! Ammunition.description:
Ammunition projectile

Invented by Zo! Media prop designers, this special ammunition is designed to explode in a dramatic fanfare fit for a media production without sacrificing any lethality. A weapon loaded with POW! ammunition automatically attempts to [[/act feint]] targets within its first range increment. Targets of your Feint are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against ranged attacks in your first range increment rather than melee attacks, depending on the result of the save.
Pow! Ammunition.name: Pow! Ammunition

Predictive Eyes (Commercial).description:
Using predictive algorithms and minor divinations, runic lenses transmit information at a rapid pace to the parietal lobe of your brain, helping you avoid danger.

Activate—Track Movement 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Choose one creature within 60 feet that you can see. Your predictive eyes track that creature to give you split-second predictions of its actions. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws against attacks and effects from that creature. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RDwKC2xVJVhCjGlE]{Anticipate Danger} class feat, this bonus applies to your Perception DC when you Anticipate Danger.
Predictive Eyes (Commercial).name: Predictive Eyes (Commercial)

Predictive Eyes (Tactical).description:
Using predictive algorithms and minor divinations, runic lenses transmit information at a rapid pace to the parietal lobe of your brain, helping you avoid danger.

Activate—Track Movement 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Choose up to 2 creatures within 60 feet that you can see. Your predictive eyes track those creatures to give you split-second predictions of their actions. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws against attacks and effects from those creatures. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RDwKC2xVJVhCjGlE]{Anticipate Danger} class feat, this bonus applies to your Perception DC when you Anticipate Danger.
Predictive Eyes (Tactical).name: Predictive Eyes (Tactical)

Presence Intensifier.description:
This augmentation strengthens your personality, intensifying the parts of you that form the core of your identity. You gain a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. When you get this augmentation, you either increase your Charisma modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

Activate—Irresistible Idea 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You manipulate your cosmetics to influence a creature as a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} (DC 38).
Presence Intensifier.name: Presence Intensifier

Programmer's Plushie (Advanced).description:
These miniatures come in many shapes, often resembling a programmer's personal avatar or popular media character, such as Captain Concierge or Zo!. The plush helps organize your thoughts; you gain a +3 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Secret Password 2 (auditory)

Effect You whisper a secret passcode known only to yourself and your programmer's plushie, securing a computer, container, door, or lock from intrusion as a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock} with a DC of 35. Any creature can bypass this lock using the passcode while touching the target with the programmer's plushie.
Programmer's Plushie (Advanced).name: Programmer's Plushie (Advanced)

Programmer's Plushie (Commercial).description:
These miniatures come in many shapes, often resembling a programmer's personal avatar or popular media character, such as Captain Concierge or Zo!. The plush helps organize your thoughts; you gain a +1 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Secret Password 2 (auditory)

Effect You whisper a secret passcode known only to yourself and your programmer's plushie, securing a computer, container, door, or lock from intrusion as a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock} with a DC of 18. Any creature can bypass this lock using the passcode while touching the target with the programmer's plushie.
Programmer's Plushie (Commercial).name: Programmer's Plushie (Commercial)

Programmer's Plushie (Tactical).description:
These miniatures come in many shapes, often resembling a programmer's personal avatar or popular media character, such as Captain Concierge or Zo!. The plush helps organize your thoughts; you gain a +2 item bonus to Computers checks.

Activate—Secret Password 2 (auditory)

Effect You whisper a secret passcode known only to yourself and your programmer's plushie, securing a computer, container, door, or lock from intrusion as a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock} with a DC of 25. Any creature can bypass this lock using the passcode while touching the target with the programmer's plushie.
Programmer's Plushie (Tactical).name: Programmer's Plushie (Tactical)

Prosthetic Limb.description: This prosthesis replaces a missing or damaged limb. Prosthetic limbs are common augmentations available at UPB printing kiosks on many worlds and come in many different materials and sizes. The augmentation restores functionality, including the ability to install other augmentations in the limb, but it's no more durable than and doesn't otherwise function differently from the replaced limb. A prosthetic limb can replace one you've lost, or you can have a limb removed to replace it with a prosthetic. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
Prosthetic Limb.name: Prosthetic Limb

Psychic Fedora (Advanced).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[6d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Advanced).name: Psychic Fedora (Advanced)

Psychic Fedora (Commercial).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[2d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:18|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Commercial).name: Psychic Fedora (Commercial)

Psychic Fedora (Elite).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[10d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:39|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Elite).name: Psychic Fedora (Elite)

Psychic Fedora (Superior).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku]{Psychic Interrogation}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]{Read Mental Dossier}, and the Psychic Tap ability of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[8d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:34|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Superior).name: Psychic Fedora (Superior)

Psychic Fedora (Tactical).description:
This unassuming fedora amplifies the wearer's psychic power. If you have limited telepathy, creatures who are within range of your limited telepathy and to whom you can send messages to take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saving throws against Mental Dart, Psychic Interrogation, Read Mental Dossier, and the Psychic Tap ability of intercepting ears.

Activate—Mental Dart 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You run your hand along the fedora's brim, pushing your thoughts into the mind of a creature within 30 feet. That target takes @Damage[4d6[mental]|traits:nonlethal|shortLabel] nonlethal mental damage (@Check[will|dc:23|basic] save).
Psychic Fedora (Tactical).name: Psychic Fedora (Tactical)

Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial).description:
Your irises are injected with psychoactive dyes that cause a signature kaleidoscopic effect, or your eyes have been completely replaced with delicate magitech devices. You can activate these dyes to enthrall those you look upon with varying effects depending on the item's type.

Activate—Gaze 2 (concentrate, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:17] saving throw with the following results.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated for as long as it can see you. Taking a hostile action against the creature ends the effect.
Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial).name: Psychoactive Eyes (Commercial)

Psychoactive Eyes (Tactical).description:
Your irises are injected with psychoactive dyes that cause a signature kaleidoscopic effect, or your eyes have been completely replaced with delicate magitech devices. You can activate these dyes to enthrall those you look upon with varying effects depending on the item's type.

Activate—Gaze 2 (concentrate, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:20] saving throw with the following results.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated and becomes helpful for as long as it can see you. Taking a hostile action against the creature ends the effect.
Psychoactive Eyes (Tactical).name: Psychoactive Eyes (Tactical)

Pulse Gauntlet.description:
Upgrades: 1

Popularized in underground fighting circles, this heavy-duty nanocarbon glove amplifies and weaponizes sounds made by its wielder, generating a sonic boom strong enough to knock an enemy off their feet.
Pulse Gauntlet.name: Pulse Gauntlet

Pulsecaster Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This imposing pistol fires a jolt of paralyzing electricity from its barrel. Its remaining charges are visible as glowing lines of energy radiating down its body. Pulsecaster pistols are often used by bounty hunters and law enforcement who need to keep their targets alive.
Pulsecaster Pistol.name: Pulsecaster Pistol

Puzzleblade.description:
Upgrades: 1

This kasathan sword breaks down into interlocking pieces for storage and transport. Traditionalists practice the art of ritually assembling puzzleblades, with different pieces symbolizing the kasathan virtues of conviction, dedication, moderation, and tradition. Criminals and smugglers value the puzzleblade for its discreet design.
Puzzleblade.name: Puzzleblade

Quantum Reaver.description:
The edge of this glowing, several-foot-long blade wavers and blurs, and reality seems to fracture when it's swung, offering fleeting glimpses of other worlds along its path. The quantum reaver is an advanced-grade weapon, and can be improved as normal.

Activate—Spatial Slice 2

Frequency once every 10 minutes

Effect You phase the quantum reaver through space-time, making a melee Strike against any creature within 30 feet as if you were adjacent to it. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 3 rounds.
Quantum Reaver.name: Quantum Reaver

Quasar Crystal.description: Quasar crystals condense your solar energy into a single point ready to release on impact. Attacks with this weapon are a critical hit on a 19 on the die as long as that result is a success. This property has no effect on a 19 if the result would be a failure.
Quasar Crystal.name: Quasar Crystal

Quicklock.description: A quicklock weapon has multiple tracking devices and additional computer processors to increase the rapidity of its built-in targeting systems, allowing its wielder to strike rapidly. While wielding a quicklock weapon, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition, but you can use the additional action granted only to make a Strike with the weapon.
Quicklock.name: Quicklock

Quilted Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

This armor is made of layered fabrics stitched together and is popular with scavengers. On Akiton, some suits of quilted armor are actually constructed of heirloom blankets and garments repurposed for protection.
Quilted Armor.name: Quilted Armor

Radiant Star Mote.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A single mote of light shines in this glass vial, emitting bright light in a 20-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 20 feet. When you open the vial, the mote collides with a creature within 60 feet of your choice. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} as their equilibrium is wildly thrown off, and begins to glow like a star (bright light for 20 feet, then dim light for 20 more). During the duration, if the creature was or becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed or becomes concealed for any other reason, they are no longer concealed. They must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19] save; a willing creature can choose to fail or critically fail.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is affected for 1 round.

Failure The creature is affected for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is affected for 10 minutes.
Radiant Star Mote.name: Radiant Star Mote

Radiation Buffer (Advanced).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 8 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +3 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Advanced).name: Radiation Buffer (Advanced)

Radiation Buffer (Commercial).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 2 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Commercial).name: Radiation Buffer (Commercial)

Radiation Buffer (Superior).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 12 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +4 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Superior).name: Radiation Buffer (Superior)

Radiation Buffer (Tactical).description: A layer of treated lead lines your armor with integrated radiation sensors networked into your comm unit. While you're wearing armor with this upgrade, you gain resistance 4 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +2 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radiation Buffer (Tactical).name: Radiation Buffer (Tactical)

Radiation Sweeper.description: This handheld device is capable of detecting radiation within 120 feet. When you Interact with the device, it emits pings in different tones to indicate the presence of low, medium, high, or severe radiation. It also displays the areas of radiation on a simple screen. It automatically updates the data as you move until the beginning of your next turn. After that, you must Interact with the device again to conduct another sweep. A radiation sweeper can't detect radiation through 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force field. A radiation sweeper is immune to the effects of radiation.
Radiation Sweeper.name: Radiation Sweeper

Raptorial Edge.description:
Upgrades: 1

This macabre weapon integrates still-living biological material from a Krethiskar Swarm component, kept vital by necromancy and power from the weapon's battery. When this superior phase cutlass is powered, it deals mental damage rather than void damage as the szandite crystals within it project a sickly glow that surrounds the blade.

One of the raptorial edge's upgrade slots has a unique 8th-level upgrade permanently installed with the acid, magical, and tech traits. This upgrade causes the weapon to deal an additional 1d6 acid damage, plus 1d10 persistent acid damage on a critical hit. The upgrade cannot be removed, but it can be improved for 60,000 credits to a 15th-level upgrade. This improvement increases the persistent acid damage on a critical hit to 2d10 and causes all acid damage dealt by the raptorial edge to ignore a target's acid resistance.

Activate—Mind Slice f (mental)

Trigger You critically hit with a Strike with the raptorial edge

Effect You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target and find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours, unless the target succeeds at a @Check[will|dc:28] save.
Raptorial Edge.name: Raptorial Edge

Reaction Breacher.description:
Upgrades: 1

This portable reaction cannon launches flak from miniature cluster missiles that rip through a fortified structure and anyone unfortunate enough to be inside.
Reaction Breacher.name: Reaction Breacher

Reality Distorter.description:
This device emits ripples of energy creating small distortions within reality around your foes.

Activate—Distort! r

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature moves adjacent to you

Effect Your armor unleashes a bubble of distorted reality keyed to the quantum signature of the triggering creature in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on you that lasts 1 minute. The triggering creature treats the area as difficult terrain.
Reality Distorter.name: Reality Distorter

Reality Ripper.description:
This sleek rifle converts energy into projectiles of concentrated magic that tears apart matter by destroying its bindings to the reality. A reality ripper is modular and has two modes: destructive and reaping. While in destructive mode, the reality ripper deals acid damage and gains the razing trait. While in reaping mode, a reality ripper deals void damage and gains the concussive trait.

A realty ripper's minimum weapon improvement is tactical, meaning its tracking +1 cannot be removed, though further improvements can be still applied.
Reality Ripper.name: Reality Ripper

Regenerative Rune Splice.description:
Your genes are enchanted with microscopic runes that you can activate to recover from traumatic injury.

Activate—Regenerate 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.s6J1Q0e28Gb42epQ]{Genetic Regeneration} spell.
Regenerative Rune Splice.name: Regenerative Rune Splice

Repair Toolkit (Commercial).description: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
Repair Toolkit (Commercial).name: Repair Toolkit (Commercial)

Repair Toolkit (Tactical).description: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. A tactical repair toolkit gives you a +1 item bonus to the check. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
Repair Toolkit (Tactical).name: Repair Toolkit (Tactical)

Replay Datamine (Advanced).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +23 and master skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Advanced).name: Replay Datamine (Advanced)

Replay Datamine (Commercial).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +2 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +9 and trained skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Commercial).name: Replay Datamine (Commercial)

Replay Datamine (Superior).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +4 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +37 and master skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Superior).name: Replay Datamine (Superior)

Replay Datamine (Tactical).description:
This small yellow disc with black stripes can record up to 10 minutes of video. The datamine's video cannot be changed once it's recorded. It provides a +3 status bonus to Computers checks for 1 minute to Hack a computer to display, broadcast, or record the recorded video.

Activate—Datamine Autohack 2 (manipulate) The datamine replaces the video output of the attached system with the recording. It attempts a Computers check to Hack the broadcast with a modifier of +16 and expert skill proficiency.
Replay Datamine (Tactical).name: Replay Datamine (Tactical)

Replica Zo! Microphone.description:
Upgrades 1

This ornate replica of the undead superstar's iconic microphone is an officially licensed Zo! Media product. Zo!'s microphone is rumored to be a bone scepter upgraded with the latest technologies to amplify Zo!'s voice for blasting enemies or unruly fans. The replica version possesses similar capabilities and can be used as a professional microphone or a weapon.
Replica Zo! Microphone.name: Replica Zo! Microphone

Resist Energy Spell Amp (Advanced).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} spell
Resist Energy Spell Amp (Advanced).name: Resist Energy Spell Amp (Advanced)

Resist Energy Spell Amp (Commercial).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} spell
Resist Energy Spell Amp (Commercial).name: Resist Energy Spell Amp (Commercial)

Resist Energy Spell Amp (Tactical).description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} spell
Resist Energy Spell Amp (Tactical).name: Resist Energy Spell Amp (Tactical)

Retinal Reflectors.description: These sheets of reflective material, implanted in your visual organs, enhance your vision without changing your appearance. You gain low-light vision and a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} if they involve sight.
Retinal Reflectors.name: Retinal Reflectors

Retrieval Boosters.description: When you make a thrown Strike with this weapon, a complex combination of stabilizers and boosters propels it back into your free hand (or other appendage) after the Strike is complete. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.
Retrieval Boosters.name: Retrieval Boosters

Retrocognitive Lens.description:
The outer rim of this high-tech magnifying glass is etched with occult symbols that grant it the ability to peer into the past with the right calibrations. Retrocognitive lenses can be made to augment other senses, most commonly smell, for use by blind creatures. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} while using the lens.

Activation—Psychic Clues (concentrate, manipulate, occult) 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Effect By holding the lens up to one eye and adjusting its focus, you can see psychic impressions of events that occurred in your current vicinity over the course of the previous day. You can examine these echoes for 1 minute, gaining vague clues about what occurred during that time period. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] for 24 hours when questioning creatures who were present or know what happened during that time. These clues come in the form of emotional remnants and cryptic symbolism rather than clear visions. At the GM's discretion, if you learn about a particularly traumatic event, you must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:34] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 hour (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} on a critical failure).
Retrocognitive Lens.name: Retrocognitive Lens

Reusable Grenade Shell.description:
This ordinance was originally shaped like a brutaris ball and intended to add both visual effects and additional risk to the already dangerous game. You can throw the shell to explode the installed grenade, using the grenade's range, damage, and other effects. The shell remains and repairs the grenade over the course of 24 hours, during which time you can't install another grenade. The shell is too large for a grenade launcher.

Activate—Install Grenade 1 (manipulate)

Effect You install a commercial, tactical, or advanced grenade in the shell. You can store one grenade in the shell at a time, and you can Interact to retrieve the grenade normally.
Reusable Grenade Shell.name: Reusable Grenade Shell

Revealing Flashlight.description: This pale green torch has been modified to shine an ethereal wavelength of light. When activated, it emits only 30 feet of dim light and no bright light. When the light passes through a container, it reveals a silhouette of any items within. This gives the wielder a +2 item bonus to [[/act seek]] hidden treasures within the dim light. The presence of bright light counteracts this effect.
Revealing Flashlight.name: Revealing Flashlight

Riot Shield.description: Riot shields are constructed from sheets of transparent aluminum reinforced with nanocarbon panels layered over polymers or resins. These sleek but sturdy shields are designed to protect most of the wielder's body when raised while allowing them to march in tight tactical formations. Sometimes they're transparent to allow inexperienced wielders to see the other side while the shield is raised, but most experienced warriors have no problem seeing around these shields, and the transparent material quickly becomes too scuffed to see through after a few hits.
Riot Shield.name: Riot Shield

Rotating Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

A time-tested design favored by traditional gunslingers, the multiple barrels on this pistol mechanically rotate while firing, making it less likely to malfunction.
Rotating Pistol.name: Rotating Pistol

Rotolaser.description:
Upgrades: 1

A rotolaser fires multiple beams of plasma at once. This massive assault rifle has a set of rotating barrels that prevent overheating when spewing auto-fire.
Rotolaser.name: Rotolaser

Safekeep Flashlight.description:
This blocky flashlight sheds a soothing orange glow that seems to reassure the user of their safety in an almost childlike way.

Activate—Go Away A (light, manipulate) You concentrate the light on something scary to ward it off. You cast a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} spell (@Check[will|dc:23|traits:concentrate,emotion,fear,light,manipulate,mental|options:spell] save) on a creature with the aberration or undead traits. A creature that succeeds on their save against the spell becomes immune to Go Away for 24 hours.
Safekeep Flashlight.name: Safekeep Flashlight

Scattergun.description:
Upgrades: 1

A scattergun is a long-barreled firearm that fires numerous spherical projectiles to hit multiple targets.
Scattergun.name: Scattergun

Screamer.description:
Upgrades: 1

Resembling a large directional speaker held in two hands, a screamer produces a deafening boom. At lower volumes, a screamer functions as a portable loudspeaker.
Screamer.name: Screamer

Second Skin.description:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
Second Skin.name: Second Skin

Seeker Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This single-shot sniper rifle is one of the most popular weapons in the Vast thanks to its stability and reliability with minimal upkeep.
Seeker Rifle.name: Seeker Rifle

Semi-Auto Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
Semi-Auto Pistol.name: Semi-Auto Pistol

Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid enhances your senses and reduces the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 1 against your ranged Strikes for 5 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.UB0yKVxoS0EBXyCO]{Effect: Sharpshooter Serum}
Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial).name: Sharpshooter Serum (Commercial)

Sharpshooter Serum (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid enhances your senses and reduces the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 2 against your ranged Strikes for 5 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment-effects.Item.UB0yKVxoS0EBXyCO]{Effect: Sharpshooter Serum}
Sharpshooter Serum (Tactical).name: Sharpshooter Serum (Tactical)

Shielding Skin (Advanced).description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws.
Shielding Skin (Advanced).name: Shielding Skin (Advanced)

Shielding Skin (Commercial).description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws.
Shielding Skin (Commercial).name: Shielding Skin (Commercial)

Shielding Skin (Tactical).description: Your skin is biologically engineered to protect your entire body, including your brain, from harmful effects. You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws.
Shielding Skin (Tactical).name: Shielding Skin (Tactical)

Shimmerstone Serum.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A blue tincture distilled from shimmerstone. You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects and a +2 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} for 10 minutes.
Shimmerstone Serum.name: Shimmerstone Serum

Shirren-eye Rifle.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sniper rifle comes with a compound technological scope that allows snipers to adjust focus and magnification with natural eye movements instead of using moving parts that might disrupt their aim.
Shirren-eye Rifle.name: Shirren-eye Rifle

Shobhad Longrifle.description:
Upgrades: 0

This martial sniper rifle is the traditional weapon of the shobhad-neh. It comes with a built-in @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.nPmeqjZ8b0mjqSfs]{commercial silencer} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.10lYyQDoJXUojKm2]{commercial sniper's scope} that must be upgraded separately from the weapon but are integrated into the shobhad longrifle and do not occupy upgrade slots.
Shobhad Longrifle.name: Shobhad Longrifle

Shock Module (Commercial).description: This circuit safely courses electricity through your weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 electricity damage. On a critical hit, electricity arcs out to deal an equal amount of electricity damage to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target.
Shock Module (Commercial).name: Shock Module (Commercial)

Shock Module (Tactical).description:
This circuit safely courses electricity through your weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 electricity damage. On a critical hit, this increases to 2d10 electricity damage, and electricity arcs out to deal an equal amount of electricity damage to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target.

Electricity damage dealt by this weapon ignores the target's electricity resistance (and the other creatures' on a critical hit).
Shock Module (Tactical).name: Shock Module (Tactical)

Shock Pad.description:
Upgrades: 1

This flexible nanocarbon circuit can be installed as an upgrade into gloves, kneepads, or similar appendage protectors to emit a powerful electric shock when forcefully applied to a target.
Shock Pad.name: Shock Pad

Shock Truncheon.description:
Upgrades: 1

Popular among security forces, this retractable baton discharges electricity with each Strike. A whirring device inside the grip generates voltage, creating a sound like a swarm of buzzing insects when it's fully charged.
Shock Truncheon.name: Shock Truncheon

Shooting Starknife.description:
Upgrades: 1

This traditional star-shaped blade design of lost Golarion is often forged from reinforced carbon steel and treated with chemicals that create an iridescent sheen. When properly balanced and honed, a shooting starknife sings as it slices through the air.
Shooting Starknife.name: Shooting Starknife

Shotalashu Armor.description:
Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.
Shotalashu Armor.name: Shotalashu Armor

Shredskin (Advanced).description:
This slate-gray garment ripples with necromantic energy. When worn properly, this magical bodysuit transforms the appearance of a living creature into that of an undead creature and grants a +3 item bonus to Stealth checks.

Activate—Necrotize 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Duration 1 hour (see text)

Effect The shredskin transforms your appearance into an undead version of yourself. Your disguise affects your visual appearance, sound, scent, and all other forms of detection, including lifesense. After the normal duration of this ability ends, you can extend it by 1 more hour by piercing yourself with hooks on the robe, causing you to lose @Damage[50[healing]] Hit Points. The duration can't be extended a second time, and if these Hit Points are healed, the effect ends immediately.
Shredskin (Advanced).name: Shredskin (Advanced)

Shredskin (Commercial).description:
This slate-gray garment ripples with necromantic energy. When worn properly, this magical bodysuit transforms the appearance of a living creature into that of an undead creature and grants a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks.

Activate—Necrotize 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute (see text)

Effect The shredskin transforms your appearance into an undead version of yourself. Your disguise affects your visual appearance, sound, scent, and all other forms of detection, including lifesense. After the normal duration of this ability ends, you can extend it by 1 more minute by piercing yourself with hooks on the robe, causing you to lose @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points. The duration can't be extended a second time, and if these Hit Points are healed, the effect ends immediately.
Shredskin (Commercial).name: Shredskin (Commercial)

Shredskin (Tactical).description:
This slate-gray garment ripples with necromantic energy. When worn properly, this magical bodysuit transforms the appearance of a living creature into that of an undead creature and grants a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks.

Activate—Necrotize 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Duration 10 minutes (see text)

Effect The shredskin transforms your appearance into an undead version of yourself. Your disguise affects your visual appearance, sound, scent, and all other forms of detection, including lifesense. After the normal duration of this ability ends, you can extend it by 10 more minutes by piercing yourself with hooks on the robe, causing you to lose @Damage[25[healing]] Hit Points. The duration can't be extended a second time, and if these Hit Points are healed, the effect ends immediately.
Shredskin (Tactical).name: Shredskin (Tactical)

Shrink Spell Amp.description:
Known on most worlds as "spell amps," spell ampoules are ready-to-use magic injections that confer the benefits of a spell of the specified rank.

Activate—Inject 1 (manipulate)

Effect 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.PjhUmyKnq6K5uDby]{Shrink} spell
Shrink Spell Amp.name: Shrink Spell Amp

Shrouding Sphere.description:
This glass sphere is filled with a swirling purple gas and exudes a faint floral fragrance.

Activate—Shake it Out 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You shake the sphere, causing the gas inside to seep through the glass and coil around you, obscuring your motions. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against ranged attacks for 3 rounds. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to [[/act hide]] for the duration. This gas can be dispersed by strong wind, ending the effects early.

Activate—Yeet it Out 1 (manipulate)

Effect You throw the sphere, granting one creature within 60 feet the benefits of Shake it Out for 1 minute. This causes the orb to shatter, gaining the consumable trait.
Shrouding Sphere.name: Shrouding Sphere

Shuriken Drone.description:
Upgrades: 1

This star-shaped weapon surrounds a tiny single rotor drone designed to return to its thrower if it doesn't hit its target.
Shuriken Drone.name: Shuriken Drone

Silencer (Commercial).description: A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.
Silencer (Commercial).name: Silencer (Commercial)

Silencer (Tactical).description:
A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.

A tactical silencer is a hybrid item with the magical and tech traits. Shots fired from a tactical silencer magically dampen sounds around them. On a critically successful Strike, the target becomes unable to make sound. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This also prevents the target from casting spells due to the incantations or sounds involved in casting, with the exception of subtle spells. The target can resist the effects of the silencer with a successful @Check[will|dc:27] save.
Silencer (Tactical).name: Silencer (Tactical)

Silvertongue Implant.description: Resonating membranes create subtle harmonics that can make creatures more receptive to what you have to say. You gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] while you're audibly speaking with someone in person, as the subtle resonant vibrations don't work via electronic communication.
Silvertongue Implant.name: Silvertongue Implant

Singing Coil.description:
Upgrades: 1

Resembling a resonant transformer circuit, this weaponized stringed instrument produces sound by using high-frequency alternating currents to cause air molecules to vibrate.
Singing Coil.name: Singing Coil

Singing Spear.description:
Upgrades: 1

Classically shaped like an oversized musical note, this spear intones melodious pitches when it strikes, creating a new song with each battle.
Singing Spear.name: Singing Spear

Skip-Bounce.description:
Elovai collected this small metallic ball and paired glove from a long-destroyed reality, where it was created as a mode of transport.

Activate—Toss and Catch 2 (teleportation)

Frequency once per day

Effect You throw the ball to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet. You are teleported to the ball's location, arriving with the ball in your gloved hand. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you are carrying it in an extradimensional container—the teleportation effect fails.
Skip-Bounce.name: Skip-Bounce

Skull of Yore.description: This yellowing skull gazes back at you with an unreadable rictus smile. When held or worn as an accessory, this magical talisman grants a +1 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks to identify undead.
Skull of Yore.name: Skull of Yore

Skyfire Armor.description:
Upgrades: 0

These decorative suits of medium armor feature exaggerated shoulder guards, stylized dragon wings, and draconic emblems across the breastplate's back and chest. Skyfire armor is often plated with gold or other attractive metals, sacrificing upgrade space for style.
Skyfire Armor.name: Skyfire Armor

Skyfire Sword.description:
Upgrades: 1

Famously wielded by warriors of the Skyfire Legion, this flaming blade is powered by burning gas held in place by magnetic fields.
Skyfire Sword.name: Skyfire Sword

Slough-Do (Commercial).description:
This wad of green slime looks like a mass of jelly, but when worn on the head, you can Interact to style it into hair-do-like fashions. While worn, rivulets of green liquid slowly dribble into your ears and down your forehead and neck, making it uncomfortable to use long-term.

Slough-do grants you a +1 item bonus to Occultism checks, and allows you to cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou]{Adhere} cantrip as an occult innate spell.
Slough-Do (Commercial).name: Slough-Do (Commercial)

Slough-Do (Tactical).description:
This wad of green slime looks like a mass of jelly, but when worn on the head, you can Interact to style it into hair-do-like fashions. While worn, rivulets of green liquid slowly dribble into your ears and down your forehead and neck, making it uncomfortable to use long-term.

Slough-do grants you a +2 item bonus to Occultism checks, and allows you to cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou]{Adhere} cantrip as an occult innate spell.

Additionally, you can activate the tactical slough-do.

Activate—Slough-Do Swirl Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect The slough-do swirls rapidly, causing occult energy to pour from it. You cast a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.jyrxfWeeCsrkhNit]{Eldritch Wrath} spell.
Slough-Do (Tactical).name: Slough-Do (Tactical)

Smoke Grenade (Advanced).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:15]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Advanced).name: Smoke Grenade (Advanced)

Smoke Grenade (Commercial).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:5]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Commercial).name: Smoke Grenade (Commercial)

Smoke Grenade (Elite).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:40]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Elite).name: Smoke Grenade (Elite)

Smoke Grenade (Paragon).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:100]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Paragon).name: Smoke Grenade (Paragon)

Smoke Grenade (Superior).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:30]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Superior).name: Smoke Grenade (Superior)

Smoke Grenade (Tactical).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:10]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Tactical).name: Smoke Grenade (Tactical)

Smoke Grenade (Ultimate).description:
Activate 1 Area Fire

This grenade unleashes a cloud of concealing smoke in a @Template[burst|distance:50]. Creatures within the area have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dissipated by a strong wind or similar effect.
Smoke Grenade (Ultimate).name: Smoke Grenade (Ultimate)

Smuggler's Grip (Commercial).description: These grips are designed to make it easy to conceal your weapon and are frequently used by detectives, diplomats, and smugglers. The weapon gains the concealable trait.
Smuggler's Grip (Commercial).name: Smuggler's Grip (Commercial)

Smuggler's Grip (Tactical).description:
These grips are designed to make it easy to conceal your weapon and are frequently used by detectives, diplomats, and smugglers. The weapon gains the concealable trait.

A tactical smuggler's grip is a hybrid item with the extradimensional, magical, and tech traits. You can pull the weapon into an extradimensional space as an Interact action, leaving behind a palm-sized disk and granting you a +4 item bonus to your Stealth check to Conceal the Object. You can't draw the weapon while it's in the extradimensional space, but you can use an Interact action to retrieve it.
Smuggler's Grip (Tactical).name: Smuggler's Grip (Tactical)

Sniper's Scope (Advanced).description:
A telescopic sighting attachment helps view distant targets.

The scope grants you a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} creatures through the scope.

Activate—Adjust Sight 1 (manipulate)

Effect Increase the range increment of the weapon the scope is attached to by 20 feet. If the weapon has a base range increment of 50 feet or more, increase the range of the weapon by 40 feet instead. This lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you're no longer wielding the weapon this scope is attached to, whichever comes first. This does not increase the size of area attacks.
Sniper's Scope (Advanced).name: Sniper's Scope (Advanced)

Sniper's Scope (Commercial).description:
A telescopic sighting attachment helps view distant targets.

Activate—Adjust Sight 1 (manipulate)

Spell Chip (1st-Rank Spell).description:
Usage installed in computer or comm unit;

These chips can be installed in comm units and other computers to allow the device to cast spells. Each device can have only one spell chip. Casting a spell from a spell chip requires holding the computer or comm unit in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. If the spell has a locus, you must still have that locus to cast the spell from a spell chip. Spell chips can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

In addition to the charge expended to Cast the Spell, the delicate components that make up the core lattice of a spell chip can be destroyed if used in quick succession. Attempting to use a spell chip more than once per day requires overclocking it. Cast the Spell again, then roll a @Check[flat|dc:10]. On a success, the spell chip is broken. On a failure, the spell chip is destroyed. If anyone tries to overclock a spell chip that's already been overclocked that day, the spell chip is automatically destroyed (even if it's been repaired) and no spell is cast.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overclock

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.
Spell Chip (1st-Rank Spell).name: Spell Chip (1st-Rank Spell)

Spell Gem (10th-Rank Spell).description:
These latticed gemstones are suspended in a silicon casing and encoded with the magical script necessary to cast a single, specific spell. Casting a spell from a spell gem requires holding the gem in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell. The spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack modifier and spell DC. The spell must be of your spellcasting tradition. The spell in a spell gem can be cast only once, and the spell gem is destroyed as part of the casting. Spell gems can't contain cantrips or rituals. The traits for this item vary based on the spell it contains.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Sprayflesh.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A canister sprays neutral biomass into a wound or area of concern (such as a clearly diseased or poisoned section of the body). For 1 hour, or until the creature fully recovers to their maximum Hit Points, you can attempt Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the target creature even if they're temporarily immune to Treat Wounds.
Sprayflesh.name: Sprayflesh

Starday Night Special.description:
Upgrades: 1

This tactical @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.K0xFwEC6Zv7ghVFa]{Auto-Pistol} is favored for its relatively cheap price given the benefits it provides. Detectives commonly upgrade their first Starday night special out of sentimentality.

Activate—Lucky Bullet f (concentrate, misfortune)

Frequency once per day

Trigger Your Strike with the weapon was a critical failure

Effect Even though your bullet completely missed your target, it managed to hit something in such a way that it still foils their plans. The target of your Strike must roll twice and take the worse result on the next check it attempts during its next turn.
Starday Night Special.name: Starday Night Special

Starfall Pistol.description:
Upgrades: 1

While originally a kit-bashed plasma caster, the commercial models fire streams of superheated plasma. Akitonian revelers enjoy discharging these pistols into the air during outdoor celebrations.
Starfall Pistol.name: Starfall Pistol

Stellar Cannon.description:
Upgrades: 1

The rounds of this portable cannon are loaded with carefully positioned mini-missiles packed with flechettes that shred anyone too close to the blast.
Stellar Cannon.name: Stellar Cannon

Streetsweeper.description:
Upgrades: 1

This enormous portable cannon uses speakers to broadcast dense ultrasonic waves powerful enough to sweep a street clean of anything in its path.
Streetsweeper.name: Streetsweeper

Striking Crystal (Advanced).description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to four instead of one.
Striking Crystal (Advanced).name: Striking Crystal (Advanced)

Striking Crystal (Commercial).description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to two instead of one.
Striking Crystal (Commercial).name: Striking Crystal (Commercial)

Striking Crystal (Tactical).description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to three instead of one.
Striking Crystal (Tactical).name: Striking Crystal (Tactical)

Stun Stick (Advanced).description:
Upgrades: 2

Eyeswide detectives use this advanced @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.D4KuxPi9gqFkvZ3h]{Baton} to subdue unruly perpetrators nonlethally. The handle gives the wielder a very mild electrical shock each time it's picked up or unsheathed, so agents tend to wear insulated gloves when they think a stun stick might be needed on a case.

Activate—Short, Sharp Shock A

Frequency once per hour

Effect The length of the baton becomes wreathed in electrical energy that can temporarily wreak havoc on a creature's motor skills. Make a melee Strike with the stun stick. On a hit, you deal electricity damage instead of bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|options:inflicts:stunned|traits:incapacitation] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round; this is an incapacitation effect.

This colorful and cinnamon-smelling corsage features orange and gold flowers blazing out from the center of this circular floral arrangement; it is given as a welcoming gift during Lajok's Rekindling festival.

Activate 1 Area Fire

Whether crafted from genuine szynegator components or synthetic imitations, these grenades mimic some of the effects of the Swarm creature while dealing damage like its acidic blood. Szynegation grenades deal the listed amount of persistent acid damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] Save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, a creature that critically fails its saving throw against a szynegation grenade cannot use electronic or telepathic communication and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. These effects last as long as an affected creature is taking persistent acid damage from the grenade.

Tailblade.description:
Upgrades: 1

Adjustable bands secure this lightweight blade to a tail, tentacle, or similar appendage.
Tailblade.name: Tailblade

Talon.description:
Upgrades: 1

This stylized knife tapers into a curved and serrated blade. When powered, it spews a highly corrosive acid inspired by the armor-melting talons evolved by several species of the Swarm.
Talon.name: Talon

Telebond Band.description:
This subtle silvery band allows for long distance telepathic communication and was popular on worlds before the widespread adoption of mobile telecommunication technology. The wearer of a telebond band can telepathically communicate with any other creatures wearing a paired telebond band within a planetary range, even if the creatures do not share a language. This doesn't let two characters understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). Pairing or unpairing two or more telebond bands requires looping the two telebond bands together for 1 minute. Up to six telebond bands can be in a paired group with one another; attempting to pair a seventh telebond band fails.

Activate—Fact Check r (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You received information from a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check

Effect With a thought, you instantly share the knowledge you learned with the required Recall Knowledge check (even if you learned false information) with any other creature wearing a telebond band that's paired with yours, as long as they're within planetary range. Each creature who has not used Fact Check today can use a reaction to Recall Knowledge and Fact Check.
Telebond Band.name: Telebond Band

Telepathy Node.description: A rune-carved device of treated alloys and crystal the size of a pebble is implanted into your brain's communication center. You gain limited telepathy to a range of 30 feet.
Telepathy Node.name: Telepathy Node

Telesthetic Beacon (Commercial).description:
This tiny metal disc is etched with intricate magicircuitry and tuned for remote viewing. You must sync your mind to the psychic frequencies of the telesthetic beacon to be able to receive information from it; this process takes 10 minutes and requires the beacon to be in your possession the entire time. You can be attuned to only one beacon at a time, but once you've done so, you remain attuned to that beacon until you attune to another beacon, another creature attunes themselves to that beacon, or the beacon is destroyed. You gain a +2 item bonus to your Stealth check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qVNVSmsgpKFGk9hV]{Conceal} a telesthetic beacon on your person or in a location. You can also plant a telesthetic beacon on an unwilling creature using a @Check[thievery|against:perception] check; this works like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RDXXE7wMrSPCLv5k]{Stealing} an object from that creature, except that, on a success, the target doesn't notice that the beacon has been placed on their person.

Activate—Remote Viewing (concentrate, scrying) 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within 1 mile of the telesthetic beacon you're attuned to

Effect For 10 minutes, you can hear through the telesthetic beacon as if using your normal auditory senses. If the beacon was planted in a target's pocket or the folds of their clothes, that fabric doesn't impede any information you receive.
Telesthetic Beacon (Commercial).name: Telesthetic Beacon (Commercial)
